Title: Senior Data Scientist 5 - Media Science
Description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Our Content business is responsible for weighing trade-offs between budget, schedules, and quality across the movies and shows we produce all around the world. The Media Science DSE team uses data to help the business navigate those decisions with clarity. Our metric frameworks and analysis directly shape how we enable creative teams to produce the best movies and shows for our members.

EMEA is a growing hub within our broader Data & Insights org, and we are looking for a stunning Senior Data Scientist based in Amsterdam to join our growing Studio Production DSE team. In this role, you will partner with Product Management and cross-functional product teams, Finance & Strategy, and Content Operations & Innovation leadership to scale and innovate content creation workflows. Through thoughtful metric research and causal inference modeling, you will have the opportunity to directly influence decision-making around how we produce and innovate on global content production - helping Creatives bring their best vision to life on screen.

As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will:


Be the second Applied Inference Data Scientist in Media Science Data Science & Engineering, helping shape how the discipline shows up and drives impact in Studio Production
Be a strategic thought partner for Content & Business Product PMs, Content Operations & Innovation leaders and teams, Finance & Strategy, and AI Innovation & Strategy DSE – scoping ambiguous, greenfield questions and proposing data science approaches where no playbook exists
Identify metric research and causal inference opportunities to assess the impact of media innovation efforts and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of media creation
Help Studio navigate cost, time, and quality trade-offs by delivering research that connects production decisions to member and business outcomes
Own your research agenda end to end - from design and execution on causal analysis through to interpretation and dissemination
Present your research and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, translating complex analysis into decisions leadership can act on
Build and maintain strong partnerships with a variety of business and product stakeholders, working directly with them to introduce and influence data-informed ways of working
Collaborate with exceptional Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers in-region and globally to explore our operational data and uncover insights that help creative teams produce even better shows and movies for our members
Serve as a regional expert on Studio Data Science & Engineering, helping educate and connect regional offices to existing research and data solutions from across the team


About You


Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or related quantitative field
5+ years of relevant experience with a variety of causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental designs and managing complexities around smaller sample sizes
Strong statistical knowledge and intuition, utilized in observational causal analysis and applied machine learning settings, with demonstrated business impact
An expert in SQL and Python
Proven track record wrangling data, performing exploratory data analysis, designing metrics and tests, building causal inference solutions, and articulating data stories to deliver meaningful business impact
Strong verbal and written communicator who can develop and deepen effective relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to less technical audiences
A self-starter with a learning mindset who is exceptionally curious – eagerly diving into new spaces and bringing informed ideas to the table
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; able to take ownership and thrive with minimal oversight and process
Thrilled about innovating in the Content Production domain via novel experimental techniques and comfortable taking (smart) risks in your work
Extensive experience within the EMEA region, adept at working across different cultures on a globally-distributed team, collaborating with fellow team members and partners to ideate on and deliver impactful research
Netflix culture resonates with you
Plus: Experience creating data products and dashboards such as Tableau
Plus: Designing and analyzing A/B tests

Title: Junior Climate Data Scientist
Description:
Turn climate data into investment insight.

Research, develop and maintain robust climate analytics that help investment professionals assess how companies and portfolios are positioned for the transition to a low-carbon economy.




The opportunity

Robeco is looking for a Junior Climate Data Scientist to strengthen the connection between climate research, data science and investment practice. Robeco has been at the forefront of sustainable investing for more than 25 years, combining rigorous research with proprietary sustainability frameworks and active ownership. This long-standing expertise is embedded across its investment processes and continues to shape new approaches to climate, nature and sustainable development.




As a Junior Climate Data Scientist, you will sit within the Investments Data Science team and work in close collaboration with the SI Center of Expertise. This cross-disciplinary environment brings together quantitative researchers, portfolio managers, sustainability specialists, and data engineers, all focused on translating complex sustainability and climate data into actionable investment intelligence.




In this role, you will research, develop and maintain climate-investing insights. You will evaluate climate-related datasets, translate investment questions into quantitative analyses, and turn research prototypes into reliable tools, metrics and processes. The work involves complex data and evolving methodologies, so your outputs must be both analytically robust and practical for investors.




What you will do

Research, develop, validate, and continuously improve Robeco’s proprietary climate metrics and quantitative models, translating emerging climate-investment questions into differentiated intellectual property. This includes areas such as GHG emissions estimation, temperature alignment, transition risk scoring, and climate scenario analysis.
Stay current with developments in climate science, sustainable investment research, regulation, and data innovation. Assess their relevance for Robeco’s investment approach and use relevant findings to improve existing models or identify opportunities for new proprietary analytics.
Identify, assess, and analyze climate and sustainability data from a wide range of sources, including carbon emission databases, corporate disclosures, climate target registries, and third-party ESG data providers.
Evaluate data quality and address gaps through statistical estimation and imputation, ensuring that the data underlying investment decisions are reliable and well-documented.
Write clean, reproducible Python code that can be maintained and extended by the broader team, with consistent attention to version control, testing, and documentation.
Build tools, dashboards, and reports that communicate climate insights to portfolio managers, sustainability specialists, and other stakeholders, including colleagues without a data science background.
Collaborate with portfolio management teams to analyze the impact of climate-related investment constraints and objectives on portfolio composition.
Stay current with developments in climate science, sustainability regulation, and data innovation, and bring relevant insights back to the team.




Examples of questions you may work on

How can reported emissions, estimated emissions and company targets be combined to form a forward-looking view of decarbonisation?
Which climate indicators provide useful information beyond a company’s current carbon footprint?
How do climate objectives or portfolio constraints affect investment exposures, risk and diversification?
Where can automation or carefully governed AI reduce manual work without weakening analytical control?







What you bring

A master’s degree in a quantitative field such as econometrics, mathematics, data science, computer science, engineering, physics, environmental science or a related discipline.
Up to approximately three years of relevant professional experience. Strong graduates are particularly encouraged to apply.
Strong analytical and programming skills in Python, including experience with the Python data stack such as pandas and NumPy.
Experience working with structured data and SQL. Familiarity with PySpark, Databricks, Git, dashboards or web applications is an advantage.
An interest in climate change, sustainable investing and financial markets. Prior climate-data or investment experience is helpful, but not essential.
Care for data quality, methodological consistency, readable code and clear documentation.
The ability to explain complex topics clearly and work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, sound judgement, independence and a practical mindset. You are comfortable investigating an unfamiliar problem and asking for input when needed.
Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.




Research shows that female candidates only apply if they meet 100% of the requirements, while male candidates already do so at 60%. Are you hesitant about whether you meet all requirements? Please do apply, we’re looking forward to hearing from you.










Challenge:

Interesting in this position? In your cover letter, next to your motivation, please describe how you would take on the challenge explained below:




Corporate decarbonization is progressing more slowly than many investors anticipated, making it increasingly difficult to achieve portfolio decarbonization targets through real-world emissions reductions alone. How would you address this challenge and ensure that portfolio decarbonization remains both credible and impactful?







What We Offer

A challenging position at the core of Robeco's investments capabilities.
A healthy work–life balance, supported by 34 vacation days and hybrid working arrangements.
A modern, spacious office directly opposite Rotterdam Central Station, making sustainable commuting easy and including a 1st‑class NS train subscription.
A collaborative, diverse and inclusive work environment where innovation is encouraged and your voice genuinely matters.
Attractive development opportunities, enabling you to grow professionally while contributing to Robeco’s long‑term ambitions.
An informal, energetic, and highly motivated team that values trust, collaboration, and shared success.
Competitive remuneration that is attractive and closely aligned with performance.




Research shows that female candidates only apply if they meet 100% of the requirements, while male candidates already do so at 60%. Are you hesitant about whether you meet all requirements? Please do apply, we’re looking forward to hearing from you.




Diversity and Inclusion

At Robeco, we want to grow every day: as a company and as an employer. To do better, we listen to and learn from society, our clients and, first and foremost, our colleagues. We treasure the diversity of our people and the range of perspectives and thinking they bring. Just as we diversify within our investment strategies to be more successful, we know these differences within our own company make us more innovative, flexible and resilient: for ourselves and all our stakeholders. Together, we aim for a culture of connection and create a workplace where colleagues feel safe, included, valued and empowered to be their best, regardless of the way they look, where they come from or who they love. Because when we all thrive, so can Robeco.




About Robeco

Robeco is an international pure-play asset manager founded in 1929 in the Netherlands. We help clients achieve their financial and sustainability goals by providing superior investment returns and solutions, with a strong focus on sustainable investing, quantitative strategies, fundamental equity and fixed income investments. With over EUR 406 billion in client assets (as of June 2026), we serve a broad client base - from institutional to private investors - across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. Headquartered in Rotterdam with 16 offices worldwide, we combine an entrepreneurial spirit with collaborative, international mindset.




We are actively growing our global market presence and continue to integrate technologies like generative AI and machine learning in our investment processes. These efforts are supported by a strong commitment to operational excellence and to talent development in an inclusive and equitable workplace.

Title: Medior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Join Allianz Direct!

The machine learning engineering chapter at Allianz Direct is a global team consisting of experienced data scientists / machine learning engineers that have been pioneering new use cases in insurance and building a modern machine learning platform. The team is responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models in all 5 countries where Allianz Direct is currently active. We are looking for a medior data scientist / ML engineer to grow the team in Rotterdam, to build and deploy machine learning solutions end-to-end to serve business needs.

You Will Get To


Work with experienced data scientists / ML engineers and focus on building one or two machine learning solutions at a time. Develop your models end-to-end, from ideation with business stakeholders to deployment and monitoring.
Dive into a range of challenging modelling problems around our pricing engine, claim processes, customer contact center and operations. You can expect to tackle problems using classification, regression, anomaly detection, survival modelling, time series and large language models.
Utilize our mature next generation data platform hosted on Databricks, containing well organized data across all Allianz Direct countries.
Help to extend our machine learning platform used for development and deployment of a range of models, in both batch and API inference modes.
Collaborate with dev engineers to embed a deployed model into company processes.
Contribute to our continuously evolving way of working and internal packages, as well as benefit from and contribute to our weekly knowledge sharing sessions.
Work on a modern tech stack. We use Python, Databricks, AzureML, MLflow and can leverage shared compute for large training jobs.
Work together with diverse international colleagues based in Spain, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, and France.


Your Profile


Located in the Netherlands, since this hybrid role requires working with the team at the office location in Rotterdam.
Academic degree (MSc or PhD), preferably in a relevant technical field such as computer science, data science, physics, econometrics, or engineering.
A strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals. You know how to properly apply a wide range of algorithms for classification, regression, and other predictive problems.
At least 5 years of experience in a similar data science or ML engineering role.
A love for coding. Programming experience in Python is required and you are familiar with libraries like pandas/scikit-learn, and have experience doing hyper parameter tuning for a diverse set of models including boosting models.
Experience with MLOps on Databricks or experience within the insurance business are a strong plus.
You are a self-learner. You are eager to keep developing and improving, and stay on top of the latest developments. You enjoy both sharing knowledge and learning from others.
Fluent in English. Able to communicate complex topics in a clear and precise manner to audiences with different backgrounds and at different levels.


What We Offer

At Allianz Direct you will find yourself in an inspiring working environment where there is plenty of room to set up your own initiatives, in an international scope. We believe that success starts with satisfied employees. That's why we offer you:


An attractive monthly salary based on knowledge and experience, starting at €5200.00 (based on full-time employment of 38 hours).
A bonus of 12.5% of your gross annual salary and 8% holiday allowance.
An NS business card which you can also use privately, or a travel allowance (€0.23/km).
Flexible working: 60/40 home/office, for which you will receive a home working allowance of up to €40.00 per month.
Vacation days: 25 for full-time employment. You can get up to 38 vacation days per year for 40 hours per week.
A pension plan with a small personal contribution of only 3.5%.
An annual contract with the intention of a permanent contract.
A prime office location in the heart of Rotterdam, close to shops and restaurants.
Festive moments are celebrated: an extensive end-of-year drinks party and a fun summer party.
Discount on Allianz Direct insurance products.


We invest in your personal and professional growth so that you can be successful in your work and beyond.

About Us

Allianz Direct is Europe's leading digital insurer. We are building a fully data-driven organization in which technology, automation, and customer experience are central. As ML engineer, you will play a key role in realizing that ambition. You will ensure that the available data is used intelligently to continuously improve our products, processes, and customer interactions.

Title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
HTML:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen—dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet enkel technologie transformatie aandrijft. Maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen Daarom staan mensen ook centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Wij zoeken een hands-on, resultaatgerichte Medior/Senior Data Scientist voor onze Data & AI-practice in Nieuwegein. Jij vertaalt complexe businessvraagstukken naar robuuste, end-to-end data-scienceoplossingen: het ontwerpen, bouwen en operationaliseren van modellen die meetbare waarde leveren in verschillende sectoren. Dit omvat zowel klantprojecten als interne productontwikkeling.

Voor een medior-profiel zoeken we doorgaans iemand met 3+ jaar relevante, praktische ervaring; voor een senior-profiel 5+ jaar. Los van deze aantallen nodigen we ook uitstekende kandidaten met sterke technische expertise, impactvolle projecten en aantoonbare kennisdiepte uit om te solliciteren, ongeacht exact aantal ervaringsjaren.

In deze rol ga je:

  • Data-scienceprojecten uitvoeren van probleemdefinitie tot en met productie-implementatie, nauw samenwerkend met Sopra-collega’s en klantenteams in een DevOps-omgeving;
  • Werken aan innovatieve projecten en producten zoals onze simulaties, digital twins of Large Language Models-as-a-service producten (voor LLM’s zie onze specifieke LLM-vacature);
  • Modellen operationaliseren met MLOps/DevOps best practices; met o.a. MLflow voor experiment-tracking, Docker/Kubernetes voor containerisatie, en CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions) voor geautomatiseerd testen en releasen;
  • Klanten adviseren over algoritmekeuze, schaalbare feature-engineering pipelines en cloud-native deployment patterns: geoptimaliseerd voor prestaties en kostenefficiëntie;
  • Junior collega’s begeleiden door code-reviews te doen, best practices te delen en een cultuur van continu leren te stimuleren;
  • Op de hoogte blijven van de laatste ontwikkelingen in reinforcement learning, causal inference, LLMs, GenAI, AutoML – en deze inzichten vertalen naar nieuwe diensten.

Functie-eisen

  • Masterdiploma (of vergelijkbaar) in Computer Science, Statistiek, Toegepaste Wiskunde, Kunstmatige Intelligentie of een verwante discipline;
  • Medior: 3+ jaar/ Senior: 5+ jaar ervaring met het leveren van productieklare data-scienceoplossingen in een commerciële of publieke omgeving;
  • Gevorderde vaardigheid in Python, inclusief pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn en minstens één deep learning framework (TensorFlow of PyTorch);
  • Een agnostische mindset. Wij bouwen producten en voeren projecten uit zonder vendor lock-in of “Cloud Only”-mentaliteit. Innovatie staat voorop, dus een combinatie van wetenschappelijke en productgerichte aanpak wordt gestimuleerd;
  • Ervaring met containerisatie en orkestratie (Docker en Kubernetes), plus infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Bicep) op Azure of on-prem;
  • Sterke kennis van MLOps-toolchains, waaronder MLflow, Airflow, Azure ML SDK en geautomatiseerde CI/CD-pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions);
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van projecten, het coördineren van multidisciplinaire teams en direct contact met business stakeholders;
  • Vloeiend in Nederlands én Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op professioneel niveau;
  • Passie voor continue verbetering, kennisdeling en het vooroplopen in het snel evoluerende data-scienceveld.

Aanvullende informatie

Je wordt onderdeel van een grote naam in de techwereld, bekend om AI-diensten, consultancy en softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt samen met hoogopgeleide professionals die lef tonen in hun aanpak en zich inzetten om uitzonderlijke resultaten te leveren. Voor deze specifieke rol maak je deel uit van ons Data Science & AI-practice team binnen de grotere Data area.

Binnen de Data area creëren we langdurige waarde voor onze klanten door data centraal te stellen. We helpen bedrijven wendbaar te blijven tijdens transities door data en technologie onderdeel te maken van zowel de dagelijkse operaties als de strategische besluitvorming. Zo helpen we onze klanten voorop te blijven lopen door de kracht van data. Onze ambitie is om organisaties te laten excelleren met data.

Je werkt in een hightech omgeving die volledig gericht is op kennis en innovatie, met een open, no-nonsense cultuur waarin initiatief wordt aangemoedigd. Het domein bestaat uit vijf practices: Data Governance & Data Management, Data Visualization, Data Science & AI, Data Engineering & Data Migrations en Spatial Intelligence - elk met een duidelijke identiteit en focus op inhoud en oplossingen. Er werken ruim 170 professionals in dit domein, ieder in de practice die het beste bij hun expertise en interesses past.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4000,- en €6000,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week);
  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

In wat voor team kom je?

Wij hebben een fantastisch team. En in plaats van dat je ons alleen op papier hoeft te geloven: tijdens het sollicitatieproces ontmoet je het team, bijvoorbeeld tijdens een borrel, hackathon of codeersessie. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je ziet hoe ons team werkt en dat er een goede klik is.

Als team doen we meer dan alleen algoritmes en code schrijven. We geven les aan de Hogeschool Utrecht (HU), werken aan gave producten, hebben maandelijkse hackathons, sportuitjes (zoals padel- en basketbalclinics) en teambijeenkomsten. We hechten waarde aan innovatie en wetenschap en dragen actief bij aan ons vakgebied; zo faciliteren we in 2025 bijvoorbeeld talks en posters op PyData, SEMANTiCS en CLIN.

Klinkt deze baan als iets voor jou? Klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

* Experience across the complete data science lifecycle, from experimentation and development through monitoring and continuous improvement.

* Experience working with time-series data and forecasting models.

* Experience guiding data scientists or a small technical team, including coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

* WO-level education or equivalent professional level.

* Pragmatic and results-oriented approach.




## Preferred Qualifications




* Experience implementing or professionalizing MLOps practices.

* Experience working with energy trading, renewable energy, or asset optimization environments.

* Experience collaborating across software engineering, data engineering, product, and business teams.




## Skills & Competencies




* Data science and machine learning

* Forecasting and predictive modeling

* Time-series analysis

* Optimization modeling

* Production Python

* MLOps

* Model monitoring and performance optimization

* Data science lifecycle management

* Code reviews

* Technical leadership

* Coaching and mentoring

* Feedback and performance development

* Knowledge sharing

* Business problem translation

* Stakeholder collaboration

* Pragmatic problem-solving

* Results orientation




## Education & Experience




**Education:** WO-level education or equivalent professional level.




**Experience:** Demonstrable experience developing and deploying data science models to production, working with time-series data and forecasting models, and guiding data scientists or a small technical team.




## Work Arrangement & Schedule




* Location: Zwolle, Overijssel, Netherlands

* Onsite

* 40 hours per week

* Role within the Trading & Optimization team




## Compensation & Benefits




* Salary: **€5,000–€7,000 gross per month**, depending on knowledge and experience

* 25 vacation days

* Option to purchase additional vacation days

* Travel expense reimbursement

* Personal choice budget for sports, groceries, or other personal needs

* Zonneplan Academy and opportunities for continued learning

* Modern tools and professional development support

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of domain expertise and technical depth

* Collaborative environment focused on addressing energy grid congestion

Apply now to join Zonneplan as a Lead Data Scientist and contribute to forecasting, optimization, energy trading, and intelligent asset management while helping develop a growing data science team.

Title: Scientist, Discovery Data Science
Description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is seeking a Data Scientist with experience in active learning and/or lab-in-the-loop approaches to join our Discovery Data Science department in Utrecht!

You will join a growing, multidisciplinary team of data scientists working closely with experimental scientists across the Discovery organization. Together, you will connect machine learning with laboratory experiments to better understand antibody function and the biological mechanisms underlying it. Your work will contribute to Genmab’s Digital Twin initiative and help build predictive capabilities that support antibody discovery.

In this role, you will develop and apply ML models that help teams decide what to test next, learn from the results, and refine their approach as new data become available. Working at the interface between data science and experimental biology, you will translate scientific questions into modelling strategies and help identify the experiments most likely to advance understanding and inform discovery decisions.

Alongside your project work, you will contribute to reusable analytical workflows and modelling tools that can be applied across future discovery programs. This role offers the opportunity to see how your models inform experimental work and how experimental findings, in turn, improve your models.

We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of machine learning expertise and biological knowledge. If you meet the core requirements but do not have experience in every scientific area listed, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities


Collaborate with data scientists and experimental scientists to translate antibody discovery questions into clearly defined modelling objectives and approaches.
Experience in immune-oncology, antibody discovery, therapeutic protein research, or related areas is highly valued.
Develop, apply, and evaluate machine learning models using molecular and experimental data, with a focus on active learning and lab-in-the-loop approaches.
Work with laboratory scientists to design informative experiments and data-generation strategies for predictive modelling.
Analyze and integrate antibody discovery and screening data to inform molecule design, experimental strategy, and project decisions.
Refine models as new experimental results become available, assessing their predictive performance and biological relevance.
Build robust, reproducible analytical workflows and reusable modelling tools that support work across discovery programs.
Communicate modelling approaches, findings, and limitations clearly to colleagues across scientific and technical disciplines.
Take ownership of your data science contributions within multidisciplinary projects and identify new opportunities for machine learning to support discovery.


Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring strong machine learning foundations, scientific curiosity, and an interest in working closely with experimental scientists. You also have:


A PhD in a relevant scientific or quantitative discipline, with demonstrated expertise in data science and machine learning.
Experience in immune-oncology, antibody discovery, therapeutic protein research, or related areas is highly valued.
Experience with active learning, lab-in-the-loop methodology, sequential experimental design, or closely related approaches.
Experience applying machine learning to biological, molecular, or experimental data, with the ability to interpret modelling questions and results in their biological context.
A strong foundation in statistics, model development, and rigorous evaluation, including an understanding of model uncertainty and limitations.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with reproducible computational workflows, command-line environments, and Git.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to connect biological questions, experimental approaches, and data science.
The ability to work independently on defined scientific problems while actively seeking input and sharing progress with colleagues.
Excellent written and spoken English, Genmab's primary language.
Availability to work 32–40 hours per week, including approximately 2–3 days per week at our offices in Utrecht.
You must already be based in the Netherlands at the time of application.


The proposed gross annual/monthly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR59.568,00---89.352,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

Benefits

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:


Pension
Health insurance and wellness benefits
Paid time off
Employee support programs


Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the contract.

Title: Data Scientist II - Finance Payments
Description:
Job Title: Data Scientist II - Finance Payments

Team Location: Amsterdam, the Netherlands

About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

About the team:

The successful candidate will join the Data Science & Analytics team within the Finance Payments Accounting organization.In this role, the Data Scientist II will own and deliver end-to-end data science solutions supporting Payments and Accounting. They will partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex finance and accounting problems into analytical and modelling approaches, delivering actionable insights and data-driven solutions.The role will involve applying statistical and predictive analytics, as well as emerging GenAI techniques, to address business problems across Payments and Accounting. The Data Scientist II will also explore and apply GenAI capabilities to enhance the analysis and interpretation of Accounting data and develop intelligent, scalable solutions that improve decision-making and business processes.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Data, Pricing & Yield)
Description:
For this position you need to speak and write Dutch fluently.




Ben jij een ervaren Data Scientist die energie krijgt van complexe datasets, voorspellende modellen en commerciële optimalisatie? Wil jij met data miljoenen online transacties beïnvloeden en direct impact maken op omzet, conversie en klantgedrag? Dan is dit jouw kans.




House of Tickets – het bedrijf achter VakantieVeilingen, Tripper, VavaBid en Blue Tickets – zoekt een Senior Data Scientist die onze commerciële algoritmes, pricingmodellen en data intelligence verder ontwikkelt. Jij vertaalt onze data naar slimme modellen die onze platformen nóg slimmer, persoonlijker en winstgevender maken.




Jouw rol

Als Senior Data Scientist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen, pricingstrategieën en algoritmes die onze e-commerce platformen optimaal laten presteren.




Je werkt op het snijvlak van Data Science, Machine Learning, Pricing en E-commerce en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor het Management Team en onze CEO. Wat ga je verder doen:

Ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen voor pricing, yield en conversie.
Ontwerpen van algoritmes voor prijsoptimalisatie en dynamische pricing.
Ontwikkelen van forecastingmodellen voor vraag, omzet en klantgedrag.
Toepassen van Machine Learning om commerciële processen verder te automatiseren.
Analyseren van miljoenen transacties, biedingen en gebruikersinteracties.
Ontwikkelen van segmentatie-, recommendation- en personalisatiemodellen.
Opzetten en analyseren van A/B-testen en experimenten.
Signaleren van patronen en commerciële kansen binnen grote datasets.
Verbeteren van datakwaliteit, feature engineering en modelperformance.




Jij zorgt ervoor dat data niet alleen inzicht geeft, maar daadwerkelijk onze platformen slimmer maakt




Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij House of Tickets betekent werken in een organisatie waar data écht centraal staat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om nieuwe technieken te introduceren en hebt directe invloed op miljoenen transacties en bezoekers. Daarnaast bieden wij:

Een uitstekend salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.
Bonusregeling.
28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
Pensioenregeling waarvan wij 75% van de premie betalen.
Laptop en alle tools die je nodig hebt.
Volop ruimte om te experimenteren met AI en Machine Learning.
Moderne werkplek in Leiderdorp met gratis parkeren.
Dagelijks verse lunch.
Informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel ondernemerschap.




Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt als een Data Scientist. Je houdt ervan om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen en weet theorie om te zetten in praktische toepassingen die direct impact hebben op omzet, conversie en gebruikerservaring.

Je bent niet iemand die alleen dashboards bouwt, maar iemand die modellen ontwikkelt waarmee de business dagelijks betere beslissingen neemt. Wat breng jij verder mee:

WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie, Wiskunde of Computer Science.
Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring als Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer of vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring e-commerce, pricing, marketplaces of online platformen.
Uitstekende programmeervaardigheden in Python.
Ervaring met SQL en grote datasets, Looker en GA4
Ervaring met BigQuery of vergelijkbare cloud datawarehouses
Kennis van statistiek, regressiemodellen, clustering, classificatie en forecasting
Ervaring met experimentdesign en A/B-testen.




Over House of Tickets

House of Tickets is de organisatie achter de succesvolle e-commerceplatformen VakantieVeilingen, Tripper, VavaBid en Blue Tickets. Dagelijks verwerken we duizenden transacties en miljoenen gebruikersinteracties.




Met data, technologie en slimme algoritmes bouwen we continu aan een betere gebruikerservaring, hogere conversies en maximale waarde voor onze klanten én partners.




Al sinds 2017 zijn we dé online bestemming voor deals op het gebied van dagjes uit, avondjes weg en overnachtingen – altijd met hoge kortingen. Met meer dan 90 collega’s en meer dan 10.000 transacties per dag verbinden we dagelijks consumenten met onvergetelijke ervaringen van meer dan 1.000 partners.




Naast onze consumentenplatformen organiseren we zelf evenementen zoals World of Dino’s en bieden we via Blue Tickets white label ticket oplossingen voor partners.




Onze missie: Wij helpen mensen méér uit hun vrije tijd te halen. Met inspirerende, betaalbare deals waar iedereen plezier van heeft.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Data & AI Scientist




Help build the intelligence layer behind the future of hotel F&B




At Wundermart, we believe the future of hotel F&B is not driven by assumptions, but by real consumer demand. Today, most hotels optimise breakfast participation, bar revenue, and labour costs. Yet they only have visibility into the guests who already buy. As a result, they optimise only a fraction of total guest demand, while a significant share of guest needs remains unseen.




With more than 400 autonomous hotel F&B locations across Europe, Wundermart is uniquely positioned to change this. Every day, we generate millions of data points on how guests behave across breakfast, bar, and retail. Our ambition is to turn this into the leading Consumer Intelligence Platform for hotel F&B.




As our Senior Data & AI Scientist, you will play a key role in turning Wundermart’s Data & AI ambitions into tangible business impact. You will build models, solutions, and intelligence capabilities that help hotels better understand, predict, and optimise guest demand. Working closely with Engineering and stakeholders across the business, you will translate complex business challenges into scalable Data & AI solutions.




This is a high-impact individual contributor role. You will have significant autonomy and visibility across the organisation while remaining hands-on in building, testing and implementing solutions. Your work will directly influence commercial decision-making, product development, operational excellence, and ultimately our customers’ profitability.




This is not a traditional Data Scientist role focused primarily on analysis and reporting. You will develop and test predictive models, design experiments, and identify opportunities for automation, from hotel performance optimisation to customer behaviour analysis.




This role is for someone who loves building new things, takes initiative, and enjoys working independently in an environment where entrepreneurial thinking and measurable impact are key.







What you will do.




Translate Wundermart’s Data & AI ambitions into scalable models, solutions and applications.
Build a scalable data platform in close collaboration with Engineering.
Turn millions of transactions into actionable consumer behaviour insights.
Build forecasting, optimisation and recommendation models.
Develop pricing, assortment and demand prediction models.
Design and implement AI-powered decision support and Agentic AI applications.
Translate complex business questions into scalable analytical solutions.
Support Product, Commercial and Operations with data-driven decision-making.
Independently own complex Data & AI projects from business question through to implemented solution.
Present insights and recommendations to the Management Team, investors and strategic customers.
Contribute to building the Data & AI capabilities behind Wundermart’s Consumer Intelligence Platform.
Develop and implement predictive and optimisation models to support business decisions.
Analyse large datasets to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business challenges into analytical questions.
Design and evaluate experiments, such as A/B tests, to validate new ideas.
Build and automate data pipelines and analytical workflows in collaboration with Engineering.
Share insights clearly through dashboards, reports and visualisations.







What you bring.




We are looking for a hands-on builder who goes beyond analysis.

7+ years of experience in Data, Analytics or AI, preferably in a fast-growing technology company or scale-up.
Experience building data platforms and analytics capabilities from the ground up.
Strong Python and SQL skills.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions or similar.
Experience with modern data tooling such as dbt, Airflow, Airbyte or equivalent.
Experience developing machine learning, forecasting and optimisation models.
A strong understanding of consumer behaviour, experimentation and commercial analytics.
Experience translating business problems into scalable data products.
The ability to independently own complex projects and turn business problems into implemented solutions.
Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge and advise senior stakeholders.
An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguity.
Curious, hands-on, comfortable taking initiative and able to work independently in a fast-changing environment.
Fluency in English; Dutch is a plus.
Availability to work full-time, with at least three days per week from our Amsterdam HQ




Why is this role unique?




This is an opportunity to build something that does not yet exist. Rather than joining an established data team, you will have the opportunity to build Data & AI solutions with direct and visible impact on Wundermart and the hotel industry.

You’ll work at the intersection of consumer behaviour, AI, hospitality and technology, helping hotels move from assumption-based decisions to demand-driven optimisation. You will have the autonomy to tackle complex challenges, experiment with new approaches and turn ideas into solutions that are actually used by the business and our customers.

Your impact can be significant: the models, insights and solutions you build can directly improve how hundreds of hotel locations understand demand, make decisions and optimise their performance.

If successful, your work will make an important contribution to building the industry’s leading intelligence platform for hotel F&B.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Bouw AI Oplossingen die verder komen dan het experiment

Een RAG-oplossing bouwen die het in een demo goed doet, is te leren. Er een bouwen waar collega's elke dag blind op vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Wat gebeurt er met de kwaliteit als de context verandert? Welke modelkeuze maak je en hoe onderbouw je die? Hoe meet je betrouwbaarheid als er geen labels zijn? Kortom wanneer voegt agentic AI werkelijk iets toe en wanneer is het een dure omweg?




Dat zijn de vragen waar je bij AI Works dagelijks mee bezig bent. AI Works is het programma waarmee we AI toepasbaar maken voor de hele Veldsink Groep. Title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing DSA
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll


Evolve Our Marketing Measurement: Code, calibrate, and scale our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and ROI frameworks to unlock precise business insights.
Build and Deploy Core Models: Build and maintain sophisticated econometric and statistical models (MMM, GMV, engagement) to quantify marketing impact and guide multi-channel growth.
Automate Model Validation & Health Monitoring: Design automated frameworks and reliability metrics that continuously monitor model health and ensure long-term accuracy.
Build Next-Gen, Automated Capabilities: Drive the ambition toward intelligent data products [such as self-healing MMMs] using modern AI and automation to optimize model runtimes and scale our ecosystem as Vinted grows.
Partner Decision Scientists & Marketing Leadership: Act as the core technical partner, translating complex mechanics into clear concepts and helping the team connect model outputs to robust business decisions.
Champion Modelling Excellence: Maintain a high bar for code quality, rigorous validation, and reproducibility to ensure our data science practices remain clean and trusted.


About You


Proven Data Science Experience: Hands-on experience focused on advanced statistical, econometric, or time-series modelling (experience in marketing measurement/MMM is an advantage).
Deep Theoretical Knowledge: Strong foundation in advanced statistics, causal inference, and regression. Familiarity with probabilistic programming (e.g., PyMC) is a major plus.
Research-to-Application Mindset: Ability to read scientific papers, explore state-of-the-art techniques, and replicate or adapt advanced methodologies to solve complex problems.
Production-Grade Engineering: Highly proficient in Python, with a passion for building models as data products. You design your pipelines and code so they are modular, reproducible, and easily used or extended by other scientists.
Business-Minded Tech Partner: You care deeply about the why behind your code, naturally connecting technical model outputs to commercial metrics and business outcomes.
Educational Background: A Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative discipline (Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or similar).
Impactful storyteller: A charismatic and confident presenter who navigates any topic’s technicality, actively driving and facilitating strategic business conversations across both technical and leadership audiences.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per working day
Company bike leasing scheme
Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
Work from Home allowance
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation Policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€67.700—€91.500 EUR

We are looking for someone who combines:


strong applied machine learning and statistical skills,
experience with Ad Tech systems and optimization problems,
strong product and business judgment,
comfort working on production systems with engineers,

ads ranking,
auction systems,
pacing and budget optimization,
marketplace or recommendation systems,
relevance modeling,

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and backend teams to ensure training data, feedback loops, online signals, and offline datasets are suitable for robust optimization work.
  • Help explain system behavior, performance drivers, and expected impacts of optimization changes to non-technical stakeholders when needed.

About You

We are looking for someone who combines:

  • strong applied machine learning and statistical skills,
  • experience with Ad Tech systems and optimization problems,
  • strong product and business judgment,
  • comfort working on production systems with engineers,
  • and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, evolving domains.

The strongest candidates will have experience in areas such as:

  • ads ranking,
  • auction systems,
  • pacing and budget optimization,
  • marketplace or recommendation systems,
  • relevance modeling,
  • or other real-time optimization environments where multiple objectives must be balanced.
  • Well-versed in Python and SQL, BigQuery is an advantage
  • Have a structured, meticulous way of working when trying out different approaches towards a set goal
  • Be a conscious team player who understands when their work touches that of other team members and proactively aligns with them
  • Good at explaining details of machine learning methods to lay audiences
  • Solid written and spoken English

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

Title: Startende Data Scientist
Description:
Wil jij als startende Data Scientist aan de slag met AI, machine learning en geavanceerde analytics binnen één van de grootste mobiliteitsbedrijven van Nederland? En wil je werken aan vraagstukken die direct impact hebben op duizenden klanten, voertuigen en bedrijfsprocessen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Scientist werk je samen met ervaren collega's aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je leert hoe je data analyseert, modellen ontwikkelt en inzichten vertaalt naar oplossingen die onze organisatie verder helpen. Daarbij krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe technieken te ontdekken.

Je wordt onderdeel van het Analytics & Data Science team (A&DS), binnen het Customer Experience Center (CEC) van Louwman Group (~55 FTE). Het A&DS team speelt een centrale rol in de digitale transformatie van Louwman Group. We ontwikkelen voorspelmodellen, AI-oplossingen en decision-support tools die dagelijks worden gebruikt binnen onze verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen.

Je Werkt Samen Met Vijf Tot Zes Collega’s Als Interne Consultant Aan Projecten Die Anderen Helpen Om Betere Beslissingen Te Nemen Op Basis Van Data. Je Kunt Aan De Slag Met Alles Wat Ons Moderne Databricks En Azure Platform Te Bieden Heeft, Denk Bijvoorbeeld Aan


De vraag naar auto's of fietsen voorspellen met tijdreeksmodellen (SARIMAX, Prophet, LightGBM, etc.), om supply chain processen binnen Louwman verder te stroomlijnen.
Een interactieve geoanalyse tool bouwen met Databricks Apps (Dash) om het dealernetwerk te optimaliseren.
Een machine learning model (Spark XGBoost) ontwikkelen dat meerdere keren per dag voorspelt welke bestellingen van schade onderdelen wel of niet gecontroleerd moeten worden.
Een klantsegmentatie uitvoeren en churn model bouwen om samen met marketing collega’s te bepalen welke groepen klanten meer risico lopen om niet meer terug te komen in de werkplaats.
Het volledig zelf bouwen van een generatieve AI marktonderzoek assistent (RAG) in Databricks.


Kortom, je werkt aan vraagstukken die direct bijdragen aan betere klantbeleving, efficiëntere processen en slimmere besluitvorming binnen de hele Louwman Group.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Je staat aan het begin van je carrière als Data Scientist en bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe data kan helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken te onderzoeken, patronen te ontdekken en inzichten uit data te halen. Daarbij durf je vragen te stellen, denk je kritisch mee en ben je niet bang om nieuwe technieken en tools te leren.

Je Hebt Een Analytische Mindset En Weet Bevindingen Helder Uit Te Leggen Aan Collega's, Ook Wanneer Zij Minder Technisch Zijn. Je Krijgt Energie Van Samenwerken, Staat Open Voor Feedback En Bent Gemotiveerd Om Jezelf Continu Verder Te Ontwikkelen. Samen Met Ervaren Collega's Werk Je Aan Uitdagende Projecten Waarbij Je Stap Voor Stap Groeit In Het Vak Van Data Scientist. Om Succesvol Te Zijn In Deze Rol Beschik Je Over


Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Artificial Intelligence, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.
0 tot 1 jaar werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld via stages, afstudeeropdrachten of een eerste baan.
Affiniteit met data-analyse, statistiek, machine learning en AI.
Ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare programmeertalen.
Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve en leergierige houding.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe inzichten begrijpelijk te maken.
Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?


Een salaris tussen €3900 en €4400 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring.
Een laptop, telefoon en mogelijkheden voor een flexibele werklocatie en werktijden. Jouw standplaats is Raamsdonksveer.
Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband) en hebt de mogelijkheid om tot twee extra werkweken bij te kopen. Zo kun je je vrije tijd flexibel invullen.
Een ontzettend leuke functie in een enthousiast en professioneel team (5-6 directe collega’s) waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend werk te doen voor de verschillende bedrijven binnen de Louwman Group.
Je ontvangt 8% vakantiegeld bovenop je salaris, en dat wordt elke maand automatisch uitbetaald, wel zo overzichtelijk!
Je pensioen wordt geregeld via BPF Metaal & Techniek. Louwman betaalt 17,7% van de premie en jij draagt 10,28% bij. Zo bouwen we samen aan jouw toekomst.
Je ontvangt een netto reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer. Kom je met de fiets? Dan profiteer je van extra gunstige voorwaarden: je ontvangt € 0,30 per kilometer. Goed voor je gezondheid én je portemonnee.
Je profiteert van aantrekkelijke personeelskorting op producten van Louwman Group, zoals auto’s, motoren, private lease, fietsen en watersportproducten.
De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan collectieve verzekeringen waaronder een zorgverzekering en een (privé)autoverzekering met 20% korting.
Bij Louwman geloven we in groei. Je krijgt toegang tot een breed aanbod aan opleidingen en cursussen via onze digitale leeromgeving, zodat je je kunt blijven ontwikkelen op een manier die bij jou past.
Een tip-de-topper programma waarbij je tot en met € 1.250 euro netto kan verdienen bij het aandragen van een nieuwe medewerker voor Louwman Group.


Wie zijn wij?

Customer Experience Center, kortweg CEC, heeft een brede, verbindende rol binnen Louwman Group. Met behulp van de teams Customer Experience Center, Insights Reporting en Experience wordt gewerkt aan innovatieve projecten op het gebied van media, technologie en positionering in de markt.

Title: Data Scientist Compliance
Description:
Are you a data scientist who wants to build and improve AI and data solutions with impact in a regulated environment?

In this role, you will work hands-on on data analyses and AI-driven solutions that help Compliance make better, faster and more evidence-based decisions across NN. You will be part of a small specialist team that owns its solutions end-to-end: from analysis and design to delivery, adoption and continuous improvement. If you enjoy working close to the business, solving real-world data challenges and turning complex topics into practical AI and analytics solutions, this role gives you the opportunity to apply your data science expertise in a domain where quality, explainability and trust really matter.

What you are going to do


Design, build and continuously improve data analyses, dashboards and AI-driven solutions that help Compliance identify risks, monitor developments and support better decision-making
Work hands-on with complex data, assumptions and models to create solutions that are robust, explainable and usable by Compliance colleagues in daily practice
Take end‑to‑end ownership of data and AI solutions, including maintenance, refactoring and reducing technical debt
Apply responsible AI principles throughout the solution lifecycle, including AI Act classification, AI risk assessments and control documentation
Translate Compliance challenges into analytical or AI solutions and bring them into production together with engineers and analysts, ensuring they remain reliable, explainable and compliant over time


What we offer you

NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you:


Salary between €6,378 and €8,504 per month based on 36 hours depending on your knowledge and experience
13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and three Diversity Days
A modern pension administered by BeFrank
Plenty of training and learning opportunities
NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled
Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use


Who you are


You have 5 years of relevant work experience
You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Econometrics, Mathematics or a comparable quantitative or IT-focused discipline, and you are motivated to apply that background to Compliance challenges
You have hands-on experience with Python and with building, deploying and operating ML or AI applications. Experience with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, data preparation and deployment helps you contribute across the full data science lifecycle
You like taking end-to-end ownership of data and AI solutions: bringing them into production, improving them over time, reducing technical debt and monitoring behaviour, performance and risks
You are familiar with modern software engineering practices, such as working with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure), version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines, to build and operate solutions in a structured and maintainable way
You work closely with Compliance colleagues and end users to turn open questions into working solutions. You combine analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with clear communication, an open attitude and a result-oriented way of working


Who you will work with

You will be part of the Domain Data & Digital: a small specialist domain that focuses on data analysis, dashboarding, automation and AI solutions for the second line. The team works closely together with other domains in Compliance, such as Compliance Risk Management, Conduct, Financial Economic Crime and Products, and takes end-to-end ownership of the solutions it builds and maintains.

Together, you turn compliance challenges into practical data and AI solutions that are used in daily work.

You will also work closely with IT teams, data engineers and analytics colleagues across NN to ensure that solutions are technically robust, scalable and maintainable. The solutions you build are used within the Compliance domains.

You will work in an environment where data and AI are becoming a structural part of how Compliance operates. The focus is on ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement, with room to shape future-ready solutions.

You will also be an active member of the Data Science & AI guild, a community of around 100 Data Scientists and AI Engineers across NN. Here, you contribute to knowledge sharing, define best practices, and collaborate on advancing AI standards across the organisation.

Any questions?

If you have any questions about the job, you can reach out via phone or WhatsApp to Sven Damman via +31 6 27012041 or sven.damman@nn-group.com. Any questions about the process can be directed to Michèle Borsjé, Principal, Talent Acquisition Specialist, via michele.borsje@nn-group.com.We bieden je

Title: Senior Data Scientist 5 - Media Science
Description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Our Content business is responsible for weighing trade-offs between budget, schedules, and quality across the movies and shows we produce all around the world. The Media Science DSE team uses data to help the business navigate those decisions with clarity. Our metric frameworks and analysis directly shape how we enable creative teams to produce the best movies and shows for our members.

EMEA is a growing hub within our broader Data & Insights org, and we are looking for a stunning Senior Data Scientist based in Amsterdam to join our growing Studio Production DSE team. In this role, you will partner with Product Management and cross-functional product teams, Finance & Strategy, and Content Operations & Innovation leadership to scale and innovate content creation workflows. Through thoughtful metric research and causal inference modeling, you will have the opportunity to directly influence decision-making around how we produce and innovate on global content production - helping Creatives bring their best vision to life on screen.

As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will:


Be the second Applied Inference Data Scientist in Media Science Data Science & Engineering, helping shape how the discipline shows up and drives impact in Studio Production
Be a strategic thought partner for Content & Business Product PMs, Content Operations & Innovation leaders and teams, Finance & Strategy, and AI Innovation & Strategy DSE – scoping ambiguous, greenfield questions and proposing data science approaches where no playbook exists
Identify metric research and causal inference opportunities to assess the impact of media innovation efforts and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of media creation
Help Studio navigate cost, time, and quality trade-offs by delivering research that connects production decisions to member and business outcomes
Own your research agenda end to end - from design and execution on causal analysis through to interpretation and dissemination
Present your research and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, translating complex analysis into decisions leadership can act on
Build and maintain strong partnerships with a variety of business and product stakeholders, working directly with them to introduce and influence data-informed ways of working
Collaborate with exceptional Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers in-region and globally to explore our operational data and uncover insights that help creative teams produce even better shows and movies for our members
Serve as a regional expert on Studio Data Science & Engineering, helping educate and connect regional offices to existing research and data solutions from across the team


About You


Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or related quantitative field
5+ years of relevant experience with a variety of causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental designs and managing complexities around smaller sample sizes
Strong statistical knowledge and intuition, utilized in observational causal analysis and applied machine learning settings, with demonstrated business impact
An expert in SQL and Python
Proven track record wrangling data, performing exploratory data analysis, designing metrics and tests, building causal inference solutions, and articulating data stories to deliver meaningful business impact
Strong verbal and written communicator who can develop and deepen effective relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to less technical audiences
A self-starter with a learning mindset who is exceptionally curious – eagerly diving into new spaces and bringing informed ideas to the table
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; able to take ownership and thrive with minimal oversight and process
Thrilled about innovating in the Content Production domain via novel experimental techniques and comfortable taking (smart) risks in your work
Extensive experience within the EMEA region, adept at working across different cultures on a globally-distributed team, collaborating with fellow team members and partners to ideate on and deliver impactful research
Netflix culture resonates with you
Plus: Experience creating data products and dashboards such as Tableau
Plus: Designing and analyzing A/B tests


Culture

You will have the opportunity to impact the business in a meaningful way, working alongside smart people who love to solve hard problems, and who not only expect but also foster high performance.
