Title: Machine Learning Engineer - Data, ML & Applied AI
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Machine Learning Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role 

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who wants to combine strong data and machine learning fundamentals with the opportunities created by modern AI.

At Viaplay, you'll help build the models and data products that shape how millions of people discover and experience entertainment. You'll work across the ML lifecycle from understanding data and selecting the right algorithms to building pipelines, deploying models, and monitoring them in production.

You'll also help us develop more effective ways of working with AI. This includes using AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows and building reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based solutions. The goal is practical impact: delivering faster, reducing technical debt, improving access to knowledge, and creating reliable systems that are easier to develop and maintain.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that AI can significantly improve how we work but that great solutions still depend on high-quality data, sound ML principles, critical thinking, and thoughtful engineering.

What You’ll Do


Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for recommendations, predictions, classification, and personalization
Build and maintain scalable data and ML pipelines in a modern cloud environment
Use AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows to turn clear requirements into tested, production-ready solutions
Build reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based tools that support data, ML, and engineering teams
Apply AI to improve existing systems, automate repetitive work, and reduce technical debt
Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, content, commercial, and marketing teams
Monitor models and pipelines to ensure they remain reliable, understandable, and effective.


What We’re Looking For 

We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset. 

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: 


3+ years of experience applying machine learning or data science in production
A solid understanding of data, statistics, and core ML algorithms - including how to select and evaluate the right approach
Experience taking ML projects from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and monitoring
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Spark or similar data-processing technologies
Experience building data pipelines and using orchestration tools such as Airflow
Practical experience with or strong curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted engineering
The ability to review and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as automatically correct
Clear communication skills and a collaborative, curious approach to problem-solving


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience with recommender systems, search, ranking, or personalization.
Experience building AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, or internal knowledge tools
Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, MLOps, CI/CD, and observability
Experience in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another digital product environment


You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. We value different perspectives, a willingness to learn, and people who are excited to explore how strong ML foundations and modern AI can work together to create meaningful products.

What we offer you


We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 


Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst | SEB, Stockholm
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst to join the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team in SEB. The job offers an exciting mix of analytical challenges and professional development opportunities: working with big data, developing credit risk models, understanding and abiding to regulatory constraints and explaining complex models to stakeholders on all levels across the Bank. You will be part of a dedicated, expert team with broad exposure across the bank and excellent prospects for personal and career growth.

About The Role

The Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team is in the CRO organization in SEB. Credit Risk covers IRB, IFRS9, and stress testing models across all jurisdictions and legal entities of SEB Group. As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst in the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, you will be building and maintaining models that lie at the core of SEB’s risk management and capital framework.

As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst, you will:


Explore large and complex datasets to uncover patterns and gain insights into credit risk behaviour
Develop, enhance and maintain models that support credit decisions, capital adequacy and pricing strategies
Participate in regulatory and internal model development projects, collaborating with experienced quants and credit risk experts
Present analysis and findings to internal stakeholders in risk, business and credit functions
Help ensure models are used effectively by supporting their implementation in production and contributing to documentation and governance processes


You will have the opportunity to develop a deep understanding of quantitative risk modelling in banking, while continuously building your technical and professional skills in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.

The role is based in Stockholm.

You will thrive in this role if you:

are curious about data, modelling and credit risk, and enjoy using analytical thinking to solve complex problems. You take a structured and solution-oriented approach to your work and are motivated by finding ways to improve processes and outcomes. As a collaborative team player, you enjoy sharing knowledge and working closely with others, while also taking ownership of your responsibilities. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and feel comfortable explaining complex topics in an understandable way. We also value individuals who are willing to challenge ideas constructively and contribute to continuous improvement.

Your experience and background:


Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or similar
Hands-on experience working with data, analysis and modelling
Proficiency in Python
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written


Meritorious experience:


Experience with SAS and/or SQL
Knowledge of credit risk modelling, including PD, LGD and EAD
Knowledge of credit risk regulations and supervisory guidelines, such as CRR and CRD
Knowledge of Swedish


Candidates for both junior and senior roles are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer


Friendly and welcoming culture
Challenging and interesting projects at the forefront of credit risk modelling
A supportive environment for learning, development and career progression
Attractive compensation and benefits


Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 20th of September 2026. If you have questions about the position, please contact Bujar Huskaj, Head of Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, by mail bujar.huskaj@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

https://sebgroup.com/career

Title: SVT söker Data Analyst med AI-fokus
Description:
Vad Vi Erbjuder Dig

Vårt uppdrag är att göra innehåll som är tillgängligt för alla, oavsett var i landet man bor eller vem man är. Hos oss arbetar du med en av Sveriges mest uppskattade streamingtjänster som dagligen används av miljontals människor, i både stora och små stunder i livet. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med ny teknik i en kreativ och utvecklande miljö, där vi samarbetar för att förstå våra användare och utveckla våra tjänster. Vi ger dig möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom data, analys och AI i det dagliga arbetet. Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk utveckling med problemlösning och dina insikter blir en del av hur vi utvecklar SVT Play.

Vad Den Här Tjänsten Innebär

Som Dataanalytiker kommer du att arbeta med att utforska och analysera data för att skapa insikter som driver produktutveckling framåt. Du kommer att ingå i vårt SVT Konto-team där vi arbetar med att utveckla och förbättra ett gemensamt kontoskapande som används i alla våra tjänster. Det är ett strategiskt viktigt område för oss, med stor påverkan på användarupplevelsen och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Teamet är korsfunktionellt där idéer och initiativ uppmuntras och tas vidare i arbetsgruppen som består av analytiker, utvecklare, produktägare, designers och UX.

Samtidigt ingår du i vårt analysteam där ni jobbar nära varandra och delar ansvar för vår datadomän. I analytikerrollen arbetar du längs hela analyskedjan: du bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt, säkerställer datakvalité och implementerar tracking, utforskar stora datamängder, designar och analyserar experiment, tar fram insikter och kommunicerar resultat genom visualiseringar och dashboards. Du är en naturlig brygga mellan data och beslut, och trivs med att arbeta nära och samarbeta med olika team, roller och kollegor.

Vem Vi Tror Att Du Är

I din roll som analytiker integrerar du AI som en självklar del av ditt dagliga arbete för att utforska frågeställningar, utveckla lösningar och effektivisera analysprocesser. Du använder AI i programmering, analys och idéarbete, och bygger gärna verktyg och flöden som gör data och insikter mer tillgängliga för fler. Du kombinerar teknisk nyfikenhet med god statistisk förståelse och omdöme, och säkerställer att AI-assisterade analyser är relevanta, korrekta och möjliga att validera. Du hittar möjligheter i ny teknik, pushar oss framåt och driver initiativ som utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta med data.

Du har förmågan att formulera hypoteser och ta arbetet framåt från data till insikt. Du analyserar data strukturerat och följer upp resultat på ett sätt som gör dem användbara i beslut.

Du är skicklig på att kommunicera insikter genom storytelling och visualisering, och gör komplex data begriplig för olika målgrupper. Vi söker dig som genuint uppskattar att samarbeta och söka olika perspektiv för att lösa problem tillsammans. Du är van att arbeta i datadrivna processer och har kunskap om A/B-testning.

Vi Söker Dig Som


Behärskar SQL och Python
Har erfarenhet av datamodellering och semantiska lager, samt kännedom om verktyg som exempelvis Git, BigQuery och dbt
Ligger i framkant vad gäller AI-verktyg och hur AI kan användas i analysarbetet
Har erfarenhet av att använda LLM:er som en del av ditt analysarbete, samt en god förståelse för dess styrkor och begränsningar
Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga analysflöden med LLM:er
Har erfarenhet av explorativ analys och att arbeta hypotesdrivet med data
Har erfarenhet av att arbete med datakvalité, validering och felsökning
Har vana vid att visualisera och kommunicera data genom exempelvis visualiseringsverktyg

Meriterande


Erfarenhet av utveckling (FE och/eller BE)
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med realtidsdata, stora mängder eventdata eller strömmande data
Erfarenhet av användarnära digitala tjänster, streamingtjänster och/eller inloggningsbaserade tjänster


Hur Du Ansöker

I den här rekryteringen använder vi urvalsfrågor och CV i stället för att be om personligt brev. Det gör vi för att säkerställa att rekryteringen blir kompetensbaserad och att vi får samma viktiga information av alla kandidater. Klicka på knappen ”Ansök nu” för att ta del av och besvara frågorna. Sista ansökningsdag är den 27/9 men ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Intervjuer sker löpande.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Vi sitter i SVT-huset vid Gärdet i Stockholm och jobbar hybrid, där majoriteten av arbetstiden är på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Vad Vi Erbjuder Dig

Vårt uppdrag är att göra innehåll som är tillgängligt för alla, oavsett var i landet man bor eller vem man är. Hos oss arbetar du med en av Sveriges mest uppskattade streamingtjänster som dagligen används av miljontals människor, i både stora och små stunder i livet. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med ny teknik i en kreativ och utvecklande miljö, där vi samarbetar för att förstå våra användare och utveckla våra tjänster. Vi ger dig möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom data, analys och AI i det dagliga arbetet. Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk utveckling med problemlösning och dina insikter blir en del av hur vi utvecklar SVT Play.

Vad Den Här Tjänsten Innebär

Som Dataanalytiker kommer du att arbeta med att utforska och analysera data för att skapa insikter som driver produktutveckling framåt. Du kommer att ingå i vårt SVT Konto-team där vi arbetar med att utveckla och förbättra ett gemensamt kontoskapande som används i alla våra tjänster. Det är ett strategiskt viktigt område för oss, med stor påverkan på användarupplevelsen och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Teamet är korsfunktionellt där idéer och initiativ uppmuntras och tas vidare i arbetsgruppen som består av analytiker, utvecklare, produktägare, designers och UX.

Samtidigt ingår du i vårt analysteam där ni jobbar nära varandra och delar ansvar för vår datadomän. I analytikerrollen arbetar du längs hela analyskedjan: du bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt, säkerställer datakvalité och implementerar tracking, utforskar stora datamängder, designar och analyserar experiment, tar fram insikter och kommunicerar resultat genom visualiseringar och dashboards. Du är en naturlig brygga mellan data och beslut, och trivs med att arbeta nära och samarbeta med olika team, roller och kollegor.

Vem Vi Tror Att Du Är

I din roll som analytiker integrerar du AI som en självklar del av ditt dagliga arbete för att utforska frågeställningar, utveckla lösningar och effektivisera analysprocesser. Du använder AI i programmering, analys och idéarbete, och bygger gärna verktyg och flöden som gör data och insikter mer tillgängliga för fler. Du kombinerar teknisk nyfikenhet med god statistisk förståelse och omdöme, och säkerställer att AI-assisterade analyser är relevanta, korrekta och möjliga att validera. Du hittar möjligheter i ny teknik, pushar oss framåt och driver initiativ som utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta med data.

Du har förmågan att formulera hypoteser och ta arbetet framåt från data till insikt. Du analyserar data strukturerat och följer upp resultat på ett sätt som gör dem användbara i beslut.

Du är skicklig på att kommunicera insikter genom storytelling och visualisering, och gör komplex data begriplig för olika målgrupper. Vi söker dig som genuint uppskattar att samarbeta och söka olika perspektiv för att lösa problem tillsammans. Du är van att arbeta i datadrivna processer och har kunskap om A/B-testning.

  • Behärskar SQL och Python
  • Har erfarenhet av datamodellering och semantiska lager, samt kännedom om verktyg som exempelvis Git, BigQuery och dbt
  • Ligger i framkant vad gäller AI-verktyg och hur AI kan användas i analysarbetet
    • Har erfarenhet av att använda LLM:er som en del av ditt analysarbete, samt en god förståelse för dess styrkor och begränsningar
    • Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga analysflöden med LLM:er

  • Har erfarenhet av att arbete med datakvalité, validering och felsökning
  • Har vana vid att visualisera och kommunicera data genom exempelvis visualiseringsverktyg
Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av utveckling (FE och/eller BE)
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med realtidsdata, stora mängder eventdata eller strömmande data
  • Erfarenhet av användarnära digitala tjänster, streamingtjänster och/eller inloggningsbaserade tjänster

I den här rekryteringen använder vi urvalsfrågor och CV i stället för att be om personligt brev. Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Swedish Speaking)
Description:
Shape the Future of AI & Data with Us




At Datatonic, we are Google Cloud's premier partner in AI, driving transformation for world-class businesses. We push the boundaries of technology with expertise in machine learning, data engineering, and analytics on Google Cloud. By partnering with us, clients future-proof their operations, unlock actionable insights, and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving world.




Your Mission




As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll know how to engineer beautiful code in Python and take pride in what you produce. You'll be an advocate of high-quality engineering and best-practice in production software as well as rapid prototypes.




Whilst the position is a hands-on technical role, we'd be particularly interested to find candidates with a desire to lead projects and take an active role in leading client discussions. Your responsibilities will involve building trusted relationships with prospects, finding creative ways to use machine learning to solve problems, scoping projects, and overseeing the delivery of these engagements.




To be successful, you will need strong ML & Data Science fundamentals and will know the right tools and approach for each ML use case. You'll be comfortable with model optimisation and deployment tools and practices. Furthermore, you'll also need excellent communication and consulting skills, with the desire to meet real business needs and deliver innovative solutions using AI & Cloud.




What You’ll Do




Translating Requirements: Interpret vague requirements and develop models to solve real-world problems.
Data Science: Conduct ML experiments using programming languages with machine learning libraries.
GenAI: Leverage generative AI to develop innovative solutions.
Optimisation: Optimise machine learning solutions for performance and scalability.
Custom Code: Implement tailored machine learning code to meet specific needs.
Data Engineering: Ensure efficient data flow between databases and backend systems.
MLOps: Automate ML workflows, focusing on testing, reproducibility, and feature/metadata storage.
ML Architecture Design: Create machine learning architectures using Google Cloud tools and services.
Engineering Software for Production: Build and deploy production-grade software for machine learning and data-driven solutions.




What You’ll Bring




Experience: 3+ years as a Machine Learning Engineer, preferably with a consulting background.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python as a backend language, capable of delivering production-ready code in well-tested CI/CD pipelines.
Cloud Expertise: Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
Software Engineering: Hands-on experience with foundational software engineering practices.
Database Proficiency: Strong knowledge of SQL for querying and managing data.
Scalability: Experience scaling computations using GPUs or distributed computing systems.
ML Integration: Familiarity with exposing machine learning components through web services or wrappers (e.g., Flask in Python).
Soft Skills: Strong communication and presentation skills to effectively convey technical concepts.




Bonus Points If You Have:

Scale-up experience.
Cloud certifications (Google CDL, AWS Solution Architect, etc.).




What’s in It for You?




We believe in empowering our team to thrive, with benefits including:




Holiday: 30 days plus bank holidays (obviously!)
Health Perks: 4500 kr per year Healthcare Allowance (paid monthly, after probation)
Fitness & Wellbeing: Up to 5000 kr per year Wellness Allowance (payable on receipt of invoice)
Hybrid Model: 1200 kr WFH Equipment Allowance (after probation)
Learning & Growth: Access to platforms like Udemy to fuel your curiosity.
Pension: Private Salary Sacrifice Pension available




Why Datatonic?




Join us to work alongside AI enthusiasts and data experts who are shaping tomorrow. At Datatonic, innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s embedded in everything we do. If you’re ready to inspire change and deliver value at the forefront of data and AI, we’d love to hear from you!




Are you ready to make an impact?




Apply now and take your career to the next level.

Title: Applied AI Engineer
Description:
The role

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to own the definition, scaling, and expansion of AI/ML solutions at Redpine. Our mission is to be the leading knowledge layer for trusted AI data. You will develop and implement machine learning solutions that power our platform, so organizations can source, validate, and manage high-quality training and inference data.

You will be among the first key employees building algorithms for data quality assessment, automated validation and evaluation, and intelligent data matching. We interview on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application sooner rather than later.

What You'll Do


Design and implement machine learning models for data quality assessment and validation.
Develop algorithms for automated data labeling and annotation verification.
Create and maintain data processing pipelines for various AI training data types.
Develop and optimize matching algorithms between data providers and buyers.
Implement scalable solutions for processing and analyzing large datasets.
Collaborate with the product team to develop new features for the marketplace platform.
Research and implement state-of-the-art ML techniques for data quality improvement.
Work with customers and stakeholders to understand and implement data requirements for various AI use cases.


What we're looking for


Strong experience in developing, training, and deploying AI / Machine Learning models.
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, R, Scala, Hugging Face).
Knowledge of model deployment techniques and serving frameworks like TensorFlow Serving, TorchServe, or custom APIs.
Experience with large-scale data processing and distributed computing.
Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes, as well as version control tools such as Git.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable writing queries, exploring data, and collaborating on hypotheses with product and engineering counterparts.
Proficiency in independently setting up and managing cloud services that support scaling on a global level.
A Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning or similar is a plus.


Why this role

You will be one of the first people defining how Redpine uses ML on licensed data: quality, validation, matching, and evaluation. The work sits on the path between data owners and the models that consume that data.

Practical details


Based at Redpine HQ in central Stockholm. Office-first, with real autonomy for deep-work days and life admin.
Requires a valid Swedish work permit or similar eligibility. Relocation support available.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
Small team, high ownership. The same people design, ship, and run the systems.


About Redpine

If models were the first wave of AI, and compute the second, we are building the data layer that comes next. Only a small fraction of the world's data is on the open internet. The rest, high-quality, domain-specific, often critical, sits behind paywalls, in databases, or with rights holders. Redpine is building the infrastructure to unlock it.

We provide AI builders and autonomous agents with access to licensed, high-quality, multimodal data through a unified platform and API. The goal is simple: make AI systems more accurate, more useful, and grounded in real-world information.

You will work closely with the founding team, including Anders (ex-partner at VC, McKinsey) and David (ex-tech and product leader at Spotify, Zettle, and Lunar). We are backed by Nordic Ninja, Node VC, and Luminar, alongside angels from OpenAI, Spotify, and Perplexity.

If you are eager to make a meaningful impact in the AI space, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
Description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.

Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.

With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.

About The Role 

In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing



Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.



What You’ll Bring To The Role



Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.



Bonus points if you have



Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.



What is in it for you?



Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.



At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

Title: Data Scientists AI-team
Description:
Vi söker en Data Scientists som vill förvandla data till en strategisk resurs och skapa insikter som gör skillnad. Vill du arbeta med hela processen, från att samla in och kvalitetssäkra data till att analysera, modellera och utveckla AI-lösningar som ger verksamheten bättre beslutsunderlag? Då kan detta vara rätt uppdrag för dig!



Om oss



Region Stockholm är ledande inom life science, forskning och innovation i Sverige. Life science spelar en avgörande roll i utvecklingen av nya medicinska behandlingar och bioteknologiska innovationer, vilket bidrar till förbättrad hälsa och livskvalitet. Forskningen fokuserar främst på att förbättra vården och livskvaliteten för invånarna, samt att göra verksamheter mer hållbara. Innovationsprojekt syftar till att utveckla nya produkter och tjänster inom hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik och regional planering i syfte att förenkla och förbättra patientvården och andra tjänster för regionens invånare.



Arbetet för att stärka Region Stockholms förmåga till en ansvarsfull användning av AI inom life science, forskning och innovation fortsätter under 2025 genom inrättandet av ett regionalt AI-team, ett team med utvecklingskompetens inom AI som ska arbeta med AI-initiativ inom hälsovård, trafik, kultur och regional utveckling. Initiativet ska stärka den egna kompetensen inom egenutveckling och upphandling av AI både centralt och lokalt inom regionen.



AI-teamet tillhör avdelningen Strategisk IT på regionledningskontoret, vars uppdrag är att styra, utveckla, följa upp och samordna it, digitalisering och informationssäkerhet på strategisk nivå för hela Region Stockholm. Ett arbete som bedrivs i nära dialog och samarbete med förvaltningar och bolag. 



Om tjänsten



Som Data Scientist i Region Stockholms AI-team gör du data till en strategisk resurs genom att hantera hela kedjan – från insamling och kvalitetssäkring till analys, modellering och visualisering. Rollen omfattar även ett ansvar för datakvalitet, integritet och efterlevnad av lagar som GDPR, samt dokumentation av metoder och resultat för transparens och återanvändning. Du höjer organisationens datamognad genom rådgivning, leder projekt som förbättrar datainfrastruktur och analyskapacitet, utvecklar verktyg, automatiserar processer och tar fram strategiska underlag.



Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med IT, juridik och verksamhetsutveckling för att säkerställa korrekt och ansvarsfull användning av data, samtidigt som du bidrar till teamets effektivitet och samarbete.



Vem är du?



Som person är du en analytisk och strukturerad problemlösare som snabbt ser samband i komplex data och hittar kreativa lösningar på både tekniska och verksamhetsrelaterade utmaningar. Noggrannhet och precision präglar ditt arbete, samtidigt som du gör avancerade analyser begripliga för olika målgrupper. Du trivs med tvärfunktionellt samarbete och kommunicerar tydligt med jurister, IT-specialister och verksamhetsutvecklare. Med driv och initiativförmåga föreslår du förbättringar och nya datadrivna arbetssätt, och din flexibilitet gör att du hanterar förändrade krav och prioriteringar med lätthet.

Akademisk examen, minst kandidatnivå inom exempelvis datavetenskap/datalogi, matematik/tillämpad matematik, statistik eller tekniska utbildningar (t.ex. civilingenjör inom industriell ekonomi, teknisk fysik, IT).
Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av maskininlärning/AI-modeller för en eller flera delar av livscykeln (idé/experiment, produktionssättning, underhåll, monitorering).
Kunskap inom maskininlärning och/eller AI.
Programmeringskunskaper (t.ex. Python, R, SQL).
Erfarenhet av datahantering och visualisering.
Kunskap om juridik och etik kring databehandling (GDPR, offentlighetsprincipen).
Förmåga att förklara komplexa analyser för icke-tekniska målgrupper samt dokumentera och skriva rapporter.
God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR

We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer / Data Scientist who loves building and shipping features. You’ll take big ownership of Magma’s AI projects, prototype fast, deploy models to production, and help improve math learning for millions of students. Stockholm-based, full-time, 5 days in office.

About Magma Math

Magma is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education through the power of AI. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning while giving them real-time visibility into student progress.

The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.

But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math, a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths, we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.

We’re already the go-to solution in thousands of schools and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

The Role

We are looking for builders that want to work with large data sets, build AI-powered products and ship things that make a real difference for teachers and students. In this role you will take large ownership of Magma’s AI initiatives, from research and prototyping to production and iteration, working together with product and engineering.

Your Work Will Span Across Areas Such As


Digging into data, building models, pipelines and AI-powered systems
Building AI agents and agentic workflows
Prototyping quickly and iterating based on real classroom feedback and measurable impact
Deploying and monitoring models in production, improving quality, speed and reliability over time
Leverage AI to scale both the product and the business
Working closely with the team to define what “great” looks like for AI in education, and pushing the product forward fast
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll be expected to move quickly, explore new ideas, and turn the best ones into real product improvements that are used by students every day


Who You Are And What You Know

We are searching for a team member who wants to take large ownership of Magma's different AI projects. To succeed you need to:


Be passionate about building stuff with big impact
Have a big interest in AI, stay up-to-date with the latest releases and enjoy experimenting
Be very ambitious and like chasing challenging targets
Be extremely output-oriented and find satisfaction in driving projects to completion
Eager to learn new things, and have experience of building stuff
Great at communicating
Be hardworking and willing to join a fast-paced and rapidly growing startup


Requirements


Coding skills that enable you to build stuff
Strong technical skills
Hands-on experience vibe coding with AI tools
Fluent in English


Our tech stack


Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript
AI & LLMs: multiple LLM providers, Langfuse for evaluation and observability
Infrastructure: AWS
AI development: Claude Code, Cursor and other AI-native development tools


Our stack evolves quickly and we care more about using the right tools and shipping great systems than any specific framework.

What We Offer


Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn develop your skills
Competitive salary and benefits
An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society, and how children learn math across the world
Travel and meet users and colleagues around the world


Location: Stockholm, Sweden.

Note: We practice a 5 day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you :)

Our Recruitment Process

A call with the Hiring Manager.

1st interview with Hiring Manager and People team member.

2nd interview with Hiring Manager and Magma team member.

3rd interview with CPO and Magma team member.

Logga in och sök jobbet Öppnas i nytt fönster

Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför sätter vi oss in i varje ärende, följer lagar och regler, informerar och vägleder, bryr oss och visar omtanke. Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar. Välkommen till Försäkringskassan.

Hos oss får du ett varierande och avancerat arbete i en trevlig arbetsmiljö, med goda möjligheter till balans mellan arbete och fritid. Om du också värdesätter ett välfungerande arbete med dina kollegor och vill bli en del av ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag, så kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.

Försäkringskassan har kommit långt i sin tillämpning av analys och AI i syfte att motverka bidragsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar. Vi arbetar med stora mängder interna och externa data samlat på ett omfattande och strukturerat data warehouse. Vårt datalager är bland de största i Norden.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med riskvärdering och programmering. Främst handlar det om att ta fram urval till kontroll men vi arbetar även med att automatisera och förbättra myndighetens handläggning. Du bör ha arbetslivserfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data samt kombinera data från olika källor.

Arbetsuppgifterna innebär bl.a. att ta fram, vidareutveckla och förvalta urval, expertsystem och utredningsstöd i form av webapplikationer tillsammans med t.ex. verksamhetsspecialister och IT. Du kommer jobba främst i SAS EG (low-code) och SAS Viya. För att kunna ha en hög förvaltningsbarhet på våra produkter är det viktigt att arbetet utförs enligt vår arbetsprocess, där man följer den standard och de arbetsrutiner som vi har tagit fram. Detta inkluderar även dokumentation av produkten. Arbetet är omväxlande och du kommer i kontakt med stora delar av Försäkringskassans verksamhet.

Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.

Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.

har högskolexamen inom matematik, statistik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig som t.ex. en ingenjörsutbildning
har god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data
har erfarenhet av analysarbete med kvantitativa metoder
har goda kunskaper i relevanta analysmetoder och programmeringsspråk som exempelvis SAS och SQL
agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
har god kommunikativ förmåga.

Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description:
Your role

We are now looking for Senior Data Scientists to scale our Data & AI Capabilities within the Engineering Practices of Capgemini. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and AI Engineers, working on a variety of client challenges within the Automotive, Manufacturing, Life Science, Defence, Retail and Telecom industries.

You will deliver value to Nordic clients through senior-level assignments, transforming data into actionable insights and predictive solutions. You will contribute to solution design and presales activities, mentor junior colleagues, and act as a Subject Matter Expert in Data Science, Advanced Analytics and Machine Learning. Collaboration with other engineering practices to drive data-driven decision-making is key.

In this role you will play a key role in:


Leading data science projects and provide analytical expertise to clients.
Develop predictive, prescriptive and statistical models to solve complex business challenges.
Support presales activities and help shape data-driven solutions for clients.
Drive competence development and mentor junior team members.
Communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.


Your profile


Degree (Master’s or PhD) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or Machine Learning
Strong programming skills in Python and/or R, with expertise in statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and machine learning.
Experience working with SQL, large-scale datasets, data preparation, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.
Proven track record in end-to-end ML model lifecycle management, including development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing).
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch), data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), and cloud/data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).


We value flexibility to adapt in high-paced working environments, as well as the ability to lead your own tasks and coordinate others. Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, are essential.

We are reviewing candidates continuously and are flexible in discussing start dates. Most of our clients are based in Gothenburg; however, we also have opportunities in other locations. Therefore, we welcome applications from candidates based outside Gothenburg, provided they can travel as required for client assignments. Candidates based in Gothenburg will be prioritized.

In this recruitment process, we may ask about your current citizenship. This is due to some of our projects being aimed at the military and defence industry. For those openings, Swedish citizenship is required. We will also perform an ID check during the interview phase for all candidates.

Title: ECP - Model Developer and Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for a challenge within Financial Crime Prevention, with a focus on Economic Crime Prevention Models and Hybrid Detection?

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:


Explore risks and translate intelligence into recurring controls to improve risk coverage in the bank's control environment.
Test, develop, analyse and maintain models within Swedbank's automated monitoring framework for economic crime prevention.
Work closely with Financial Crime Risk and Advanced Analytics in a highly skilled team of risk analysts, data analysts, and data scientists.



What is needed in this role:


Self-leadership and the ability to drive change.
Experience within the field of AML, Fraud, KYC, Sanctions and automated screening/monitoring.
In-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms and frameworks.
Advanced statistical analysis and mathematical modelling capabilities.
Experience programming within analytical frameworks (e.g., R and Python) and using SQL, Power BI, Qlik Sense, SAS, and/or VBA.
Good understanding of the bank, products, inherent risk, vulnerabilities, threats and potential risk mitigating actions.
Proficient in oral and written Swedish as well as English.
Experience programming within analytical frameworks (e.g., R and Python) and using SQL, Power BI, Qlik Sense, SAS, and/or VBA.
3 years experience of working with data science within the field of economic crime prevention.
Friendly mindset.
Flexible remote - willing to work at site in Sundbyberg/Stockholm.



With us, you can experience:


Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.
Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.
An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.
A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.
Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.



"Join our team and...

become part of an international team of professional colleagues, who work together to deliver challenging projects, maximize customer satisfaction and contribute to Swedbank's position in society." Johan Samuelsson, your future manager

We look forward to receiving your application by 30.09.2026.

Location: Stockholm, Sundbyberg

Recruiting manager: Johan Samuelsson

We may begin the selection during the application period, so we welcome your application as soon as possible.

We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.

We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.

Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.

Title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist
Description:
Job ID: 3090

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions that directly impact Nordea's 2030 goals to modernize data technology and accelerate AI.

We are looking for a skilled and collaborative Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist to join our Forward Deployed AI team at Nordea. You will design and build scalable AI solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver agentic AI applications that drive value across the organization while ensuring ethical and sustainable development practices. 

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are not just a bank; we are a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people's daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

This position is a full-time, permanent role with hybrid working location based in Helsinki, Finland, Stockholm, Sweden, Gdańsk / Gdynia / Warsaw, Poland, or Copenhagen, Denmark. 

About Our Team   

Meet the Forward Deployed AI team. We are a collaborative and result-driven team working closely with every part of the bank to execute AI use cases. Our deep connections throughout Nordea and trusted reputation enable us to transform ambitious AI visions into practical, impactful solutions.

In this role, you will be embedded with the business areas, building strong partnerships and gaining deep domain expertise. This collaboration creates natural pathways for future career development, including potential transitions into business teams where your AI expertise will be highly valued. 

Main responsibilities in this role include, but are not limited to:


Design, develop, and scale transformative AI applications from concept to production to create technology that makes a real impact.
Translate ambiguous, open-ended business problems into well-defined machine learning problem statements in close collaboration with engineers and product teams.
Provide input to the full modeling lifecycle: problem framing, hypothesis formulation, model selection, experimentation, evaluation and iteration.
Develop and implement advanced machine learning models and agentic solutions for various business applications.
Explore emerging AI methods; share insights and build proofs of concept applicable to Nordea’s use cases.


Who You Are  

You will thrive in this role if you are excited to build AI solutions that solve real-world problems and drive meaningful change. You bring a growth mindset, collaborative problem-solving skills and excel at transforming complex technical concepts into clear solutions for both technical and non-technical audiences. 

We are looking for someone with most of the following experience and skills:  


BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Data Science, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Python, with minimum 3 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), with a focus on deploying and operating AI/ML and data services at scale
Deep understanding of machine learning and statistics, with the ability to turn a business problem into a modelling one
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical teams and business stakeholders 
Excellent collaboration skills and experience working with diverse teams including data scientists, engineers, and product stakeholders


It would be ideal if you also have: 


Knowledge of agent testing methodologies, performance monitoring and maintaining agent reliability in production environments
Experience using agentic AI tools like Claude Code/Cowork, OpenAI Codex
Experience working in agile environments or tech-driven transformation projects
Familiarity with agent development frameworks and harnesses such as LangGraph, Deep Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar, including multi-agent coordination and sub-agent delegation
Professional experience from working in regulated industries, e.g. banking, government, etc. 


We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about AI and meet most of these criteria. We value diverse perspectives and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. 

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

We kindly ask you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20/09/2026. Any applications or CVs sent by email, direct messages, or any other channel than our application forms, will not be accepted or considered.

At Nordea, we know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable workplace. We deeply believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics, and traits make us better at serving our customers and communities.

Title: Entry Level: Data Scientist
Description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Are you a recent graduate passionate about AI and the new technologies in this area? Join our Ericsson Radio Software AI Team planning, introducing and promoting today’s and future AI technologies. To achieve our goals, we collaborate closely with internal and external partners, to introduce the state of the art AI technology and enhance the Radio Product Development beyond current capabilities.

You’ll be part of a team of about 5 colleagues with a mix of junior and senior experience and diverse backgrounds. We are also working together with teams from Vietnam and Türkiye, to operate our AI Infrastructure and Data platform. As a new graduate, you’ll be encouraged to explore these areas, and we’ll align your responsibilities with your interests and development goals.

What you will do:


Operate the RUSW AWS account and support AI workloads across cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborate with the Data Platform team to enable AI access to semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata, and enterprise data products.
Establish AI evaluation capabilities, including benchmarks, test datasets, quality metrics, and regression testing.
Manage the lifecycle of AI agents and models, including versioning, rollout, rollback, experimentation, and retirement.
Help transform existing workflows into AI-native processes.
Design context-engineering and knowledge-management practices that enable agents to use reliable, up-to-date information.


The skills you bring:


A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field, with a strong interest in generative AI and agentic systems.
Knowledge of cloud and platform engineering, preferably AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.
Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, or workflow orchestration.
Interest in knowledge graphs, ontologies, vector databases, semantic APIs, and retrieval-augmented generation.
Familiarity with agent engineering concepts such as multi-agent systems, tool calling, MCP, LangGraph, or human-in-the-loop workflows is an advantage.
Experience or interest in LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI.
Strong analytical, collaborative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and learn quickly.


Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
Description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world’s largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You’ll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

What you’ll be doing


Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.


Our humble expectations


You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.


What we offer

You will work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.

Together with your lead, you will have the opportunity to create a personalised development plan that builds on your strengths and develops new capabilities.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer - Data, ML & Applied AI
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Machine Learning Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role 

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who wants to combine strong data and machine learning fundamentals with the opportunities created by modern AI.

At Viaplay, you'll help build the models and data products that shape how millions of people discover and experience entertainment. You'll work across the ML lifecycle from understanding data and selecting the right algorithms to building pipelines, deploying models, and monitoring them in production.

You'll also help us develop more effective ways of working with AI. This includes using AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows and building reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based solutions. The goal is practical impact: delivering faster, reducing technical debt, improving access to knowledge, and creating reliable systems that are easier to develop and maintain.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that AI can significantly improve how we work but that great solutions still depend on high-quality data, sound ML principles, critical thinking, and thoughtful engineering.

What You’ll Do


Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for recommendations, predictions, classification, and personalization
Build and maintain scalable data and ML pipelines in a modern cloud environment
Use AI-assisted, spec-driven workflows to turn clear requirements into tested, production-ready solutions
Build reusable AI skills, agents, and knowledge-based tools that support data, ML, and engineering teams
Apply AI to improve existing systems, automate repetitive work, and reduce technical debt
Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, content, commercial, and marketing teams
Monitor models and pipelines to ensure they remain reliable, understandable, and effective.


What We’re Looking For 

We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset. 

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: 


3+ years of experience applying machine learning or data science in production
A solid understanding of data, statistics, and core ML algorithms - including how to select and evaluate the right approach
Experience taking ML projects from problem definition and experimentation through deployment and monitoring
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using Spark or similar data-processing technologies
Experience building data pipelines and using orchestration tools such as Airflow
Practical experience with or strong curiosity about generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted engineering
The ability to review and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as automatically correct
Clear communication skills and a collaborative, curious approach to problem-solving


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience with recommender systems, search, ranking, or personalization.
Experience building AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, or internal knowledge tools
Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, MLOps, CI/CD, and observability
Experience in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another digital product environment


You don't need to meet every requirement to apply. We value different perspectives, a willingness to learn, and people who are excited to explore how strong ML foundations and modern AI can work together to create meaningful products.

What we offer you


We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 


Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst | SEB, Stockholm
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst to join the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team in SEB. The job offers an exciting mix of analytical challenges and professional development opportunities: working with big data, developing credit risk models, understanding and abiding to regulatory constraints and explaining complex models to stakeholders on all levels across the Bank. You will be part of a dedicated, expert team with broad exposure across the bank and excellent prospects for personal and career growth.

About The Role

The Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team is in the CRO organization in SEB. Credit Risk covers IRB, IFRS9, and stress testing models across all jurisdictions and legal entities of SEB Group. As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst in the Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, you will be building and maintaining models that lie at the core of SEB’s risk management and capital framework.

As a Quantitative Credit Risk Analyst, you will:


Explore large and complex datasets to uncover patterns and gain insights into credit risk behaviour
Develop, enhance and maintain models that support credit decisions, capital adequacy and pricing strategies
Participate in regulatory and internal model development projects, collaborating with experienced quants and credit risk experts
Present analysis and findings to internal stakeholders in risk, business and credit functions
Help ensure models are used effectively by supporting their implementation in production and contributing to documentation and governance processes


You will have the opportunity to develop a deep understanding of quantitative risk modelling in banking, while continuously building your technical and professional skills in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.

The role is based in Stockholm.

You will thrive in this role if you:

are curious about data, modelling and credit risk, and enjoy using analytical thinking to solve complex problems. You take a structured and solution-oriented approach to your work and are motivated by finding ways to improve processes and outcomes. As a collaborative team player, you enjoy sharing knowledge and working closely with others, while also taking ownership of your responsibilities. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and feel comfortable explaining complex topics in an understandable way. We also value individuals who are willing to challenge ideas constructively and contribute to continuous improvement.

Your experience and background:


Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or similar
Hands-on experience working with data, analysis and modelling
Proficiency in Python
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written


Meritorious experience:


Experience with SAS and/or SQL
Knowledge of credit risk modelling, including PD, LGD and EAD
Knowledge of credit risk regulations and supervisory guidelines, such as CRR and CRD
Knowledge of Swedish


Candidates for both junior and senior roles are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer


Friendly and welcoming culture
Challenging and interesting projects at the forefront of credit risk modelling
A supportive environment for learning, development and career progression
Attractive compensation and benefits


Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

If you have questions about the position, please contact Bujar Huskaj, Head of Non-Retail Credit Risk modelling team, by mail bujar.huskaj@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

Title: Juniora Analysts till Operations Transformation, Engineering, AI & Data (Stockholm) – Jan 2027
Description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling. 




Jobbeskrivning



Operations, Engineering, AI & Data stödjer våra kunder att driva strategiska förändringsprojekt där vi implementerar affärsstrategier och utvecklar deras operationella förmågor för att hjälpa dem nå sina affärsmål. Vi arbetar med verksamhetsförändring där vi använder våra industrispecifika lösningar och tekniska kunskaper för att transformera, modernisera och optimera våra klienters processer och tekniska plattformar. Inom Operations, Engineering, AI & Data finns tre olika team. Till januari 2027 rekryterar vi endast till teamet AI & Data.




AI & Data:




Inom AI & Data-teamet, som är en del av Operations, Engineering, AI & Data, hjälper du Deloittes kunder att förbättra beslutsfattande genom datadrivna insikter och skapa insiktsdrivna organisationer. Du kommer att arbeta med implementering av AI, GenAI, cloud data platforms, data warehouse och BI/analytics, med fokus på data science, maskininlärning, statistisk analys och modellering för att leverera avancerade insikter och affärsvärde. Vår modell är on-the-job-training där du växer in i mer ansvarsfulla roller och vidareutbildar dig i tekniska plattformar som Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake och Databricks. I det rådgivande spåret arbetar du med data management, data governance och datastrategi. Vi ser gärna att du har en traditionell managementkonsultutbildning kombinerad med data och teknik samt ett intresse för rådgivning. AI & Data-teamet verkar i en nordisk organisation med mycket kunskapskapital och kompetens, så du kommer att medverka i projekt, communities och utbildningar tillsammans med nordiska kollegor.




Kvalifikationer



Vi söker dig som:




Är nyexaminerad ingenjör, systemvetare eller ekonom med en masterexamen inom management eller data/data science/analytics.




Har relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – erfarenhet inom konsultbranschen är meriterande




Har goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift






Meriterande:




Goda akademiska meriter, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna




Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv




Intresse för hur digitalisering och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher






Du är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta projektbaserat, i nära samarbete med både ditt team och klienter, i en dynamisk miljö.




Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.




Ytterligare information



Vi erbjuder

Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor. 




Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.




Ansökan

Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:




CV




Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.






I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.




Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. https://tofindout.se/sv/faq/. För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.




Frågor

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare William Lim, wilim@deloitte.se




Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!




What impact will you make?




På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.
