Title: Senior Data Analyst - Bioinformatics / AI
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

ZS Discovery partners with pharmaceutical and biotech clients to accelerate the discovery of safer, more effective therapeutics with a higher chance of reaching patients and improving their lives. We combine scientific expertise, advanced analytics, AI and strategic consulting to help research organisations become more productive, more data-driven, and make more confident and robust decisions. The Copenhagen team is intentionally hybrid: scientific depth, AI capability, technical skills, and business context in the same people.

What you'll do:


Multi-modal data integration across omics, imaging, assay and clinical data
AI-driven discovery workflows and agentic systems, including target discovery, biomarker ranking and patient stratification
Knowledge graphs and data foundation design (e.g., ontologies, semantic search, GraphRAG)
Bioinformatics pipeline engineering (e.g., Nextflow, cloud-native, reproducible workflows)
Translational science and biomarker development, connecting discovery data to clinical decisions
Own discrete workstreams end-to-end
Design and implement components such as RAG pipelines, knowledge-graph elements, agentic workflows, or data-integration solutions
Develop client-ready deliverables (slides, structured outputs, written summaries) that clearly communicate insights and recommendations
Contribute to points of view (PoVs), case studies, and proposal materials, helping translate project experience into reusable intellectual capital
Participate in client discussions and present findings
Build reusable assets (prompts, templates, accelerators) that compound across projects


What You'll Bring:


Master's or PhD preferred in bioinformatics, computational biology, AI/ML, systems biology, chemoinformatics or similar
2+ years consulting experience for the Life Sciences sector within Bioinformatics
Consulting mindset: structured problem solving, clear written and verbal communication, comfort with ambiguity
Business understanding: ability to connect technical work to a decision a client actually has to make
Strong coding foundation in Python (and ideally R, SQL, or workflow languages like Nextflow/WDL)
Fluency in English
Client-first mentality
Intense work ethic
Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach


How you’ll grow:


Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in Denmark, visit ZS Denmark office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Title: AI/ML Scientist — Medical Imaging
Description:
AI/ML Scientist — Medical Imaging

Copenhagen · Permanent · Presented by Black Swans Exist




The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.




The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company's value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.




The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer - in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond - and what methods are needed to get there.




You are hired to answer that. You will be the company's dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.




Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby
Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read
Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not
Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors
Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.




What you will actually do

Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data
Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions
Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualization, presentation of findings
Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality
Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in
Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.




Who we are looking for

Essential

Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say "I built that"
A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control
Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training
Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification
Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking
Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count
PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this
Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA
A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field




Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.




Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.




What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company's first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.




What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company's hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.




Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

Title: Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Annalect, we help businesses across industries make better decisions — from marketing strategies to business development and sales forecasting. Our approach combines deep industry understanding with advanced, AI-powered analytical methods, enabling us to deliver insights and recommendations that make a real difference for our clients. In Denmark, we are more than 70 specialists based in Copenhagen and Aarhus. As part of Omnicom Media Group, we have over 300 colleagues in Denmark and a global network of more than 5,000 experts with whom we collaborate to create the best possible solutions for our clients.




Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team

Are you passionate about applying Data Science in real-world scenarios? Do you want to leverage mathematics, statistics, and programming to help our clients make better decisions? Are you driven by data and analysis, and eager to translate insights into actionable recommendations? Join Annalect’s Data Science Consultancy team!




About the Role

We are looking for a new colleague to join Annalect, Omnicom Media Group’s specialist unit for data-driven analytics and decision support systems. Our work includes analyses that quantify the impact of our clients’ marketing activities and provide the foundation for ongoing optimization. Annalect consists of 60 employees, with 20 dedicated to the Data Science Consultancy team. Our team utilizes mathematics, statistics, and econometrics to process large volumes of data, delivering business-oriented decision support. As a Data Science Consultant, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle for our clients – from data collection and coding, to building and optimizing statistical models in R, and communicating results and recommendations to clients. You will work closely with a project lead and the team, receiving ongoing support and feedback. As you gain experience, you will have the opportunity to conduct analyses independently, manage client communications, and deliver your own projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Collect client data and extract data from media systems
Programming and data processing
Structure, code, and interpret data
Develop statistical models in R
Analyze results and prepare recommendations in close collaboration with a project lead
Prepare deliverables for clients in PowerPoint and dashboards
Maintain ongoing dialogue with clients and media agencies throughout the project
Lead your own projects




Your Profile

We imagine that you:

Hold a relevant academic degree (e.g., Cand.Merc. (MAT), Cand.polit. IMM, AEF, or similar)
Have basic experience with statistical models and methodologies
Possess strong analytical skills
Are proficient in R Studio (or other programming languages such as Python, SAS, VBA, SQL and are eager to further develop your skills in R Studio)
Are experienced in Excel and PowerPoint
Are interested in building an understanding of marketing, digital platforms, and the media landscape




What We Offer

We offer a position in an exciting company with many opportunities. You will be part of a strong professional community and work alongside some of the industry’s most talented specialists. We also have a vibrant social environment, including Friday bars, annual parties, company football team, DHL race, and more. Our culture is relaxed, with room for fun and focus for deep work on projects.




Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position or the company, please contact Analytics Director Anders Mousten at anders.mousten@omc.com.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Equity Statistical Arbitrage
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.




Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Senior Quantitative Researcher in the Equity Statistical Arbitrage wing of Alipes Capital!




This position is focused on

Elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels in the area of statistical arbitrage of traded funds.
Creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the markets.
In particular, the fixed-income section of our traded universe, in which we believe there is a significant untapped signal.




In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks.
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines.
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult. It is pure play.




About you

Fluency within mathematics and statistics.
Experience working with financial data, in particular valuation and hedging of fixed-income instruments.
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
A scientific and inquisitive mind.




Nice to have

Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.




About the team

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in equity and electricity algorithmic trading since starting in 2008. We maintain an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.




The Quant team consists of eighteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities, with thirteen PhD’s and five MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. The stat-arb sub-team is a tight group of 3 researchers.




We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We work alongside a team of software engineers and a team of traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. All team members across the organization write code and drive change and are equally willing to engage on a nitty-gritty technical level as well as discuss the larger strategic level.




What we can offer you

Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.




Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and a cover letter telling us why you think this role is a great fit for you. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

  • Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
  • A scientific and inquisitive mind.

  • Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.

Title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 3090

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions that directly impact Nordea's 2030 goals to modernize data technology and accelerate AI.

We are looking for a skilled and collaborative Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist to join our Forward Deployed AI team at Nordea. You will design and build scalable AI solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver agentic AI applications that drive value across the organization while ensuring ethical and sustainable development practices. 

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are not just a bank; we are a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people's daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

This position is a full-time, permanent role with hybrid working location based in Helsinki, Finland, Stockholm, Sweden, Gdańsk / Gdynia / Warsaw, Poland, or Copenhagen, Denmark. 

About Our Team   

Meet the Forward Deployed AI team. We are a collaborative and result-driven team working closely with every part of the bank to execute AI use cases. Our deep connections throughout Nordea and trusted reputation enable us to transform ambitious AI visions into practical, impactful solutions.

In this role, you will be embedded with the business areas, building strong partnerships and gaining deep domain expertise. This collaboration creates natural pathways for future career development, including potential transitions into business teams where your AI expertise will be highly valued. 

Main responsibilities in this role include, but are not limited to:


Design, develop, and scale transformative AI applications from concept to production to create technology that makes a real impact.
Translate ambiguous, open-ended business problems into well-defined machine learning problem statements in close collaboration with engineers and product teams.
Provide input to the full modeling lifecycle: problem framing, hypothesis formulation, model selection, experimentation, evaluation and iteration.
Develop and implement advanced machine learning models and agentic solutions for various business applications.
Explore emerging AI methods; share insights and build proofs of concept applicable to Nordea’s use cases.


Who You Are  

You will thrive in this role if you are excited to build AI solutions that solve real-world problems and drive meaningful change. You bring a growth mindset, collaborative problem-solving skills and excel at transforming complex technical concepts into clear solutions for both technical and non-technical audiences. 

We are looking for someone with most of the following experience and skills:  


BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Data Science, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Python, with minimum 3 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), with a focus on deploying and operating AI/ML and data services at scale
Deep understanding of machine learning and statistics, with the ability to turn a business problem into a modelling one
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical teams and business stakeholders 
Excellent collaboration skills and experience working with diverse teams including data scientists, engineers, and product stakeholders


It would be ideal if you also have: 


Knowledge of agent testing methodologies, performance monitoring and maintaining agent reliability in production environments
Experience using agentic AI tools like Claude Code/Cowork, OpenAI Codex
Experience working in agile environments or tech-driven transformation projects
Familiarity with agent development frameworks and harnesses such as LangGraph, Deep Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar, including multi-agent coordination and sub-agent delegation
Professional experience from working in regulated industries, e.g. banking, government, etc. 


We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about AI and meet most of these criteria. We value diverse perspectives and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. 

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

We kindly ask you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 20/09/2026. Any applications or CVs sent by email, direct messages, or any other channel than our application forms, will not be accepted or considered.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.




You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.




About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.




About you

Fluency within mathematics and statistics.
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.
A scientific and inquisitive mind.




Nice to have

Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Build models on real-world product data and bring them into production

In the role of Machine Learning Engineer in the Engineering Excellence team within Software Solutions. You will work on applied machine learning for GN's products, contributing across the model lifecycle, from exploring data and evaluating approaches to deployment and ongoing improvement. You will explore advanced machine learning use cases and turn promising ideas into reliable capabilities for GN’s products.

This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of applied ML, where you will help investigate new possibilities, challenge established approaches, and contribute to creating the foundations for how the team works and delivers.

The Team you will be part of:

Based in Ballerup near Copenhagen, Engineering Excellence works with engineering teams across GN to build quality software capabilities for our products.

You will join a relatively new machine learning team, collaborating with colleagues who bring expertise in ML architecture, software engineering and data science. Together, we explore use cases using real-world product data, where understanding data quality, limitations, and useful signals is essential to building reliable models and product capabilities.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:


Explore real-world product data, identify useful features and assess which advanced problems the available data can support.
Build and evaluate classical machine learning and deep learning models, testing new approaches where they can create product value.
Take models from experimentation through deployment, contributing to the data infrastructure and pipelines they need.
Assess model performance on real-world data and improve reliability in production.
Work in Python with Azure ML, Databricks and Azure DevOps, using tools such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Use AI-assisted development tools to support experimentation and engineering, applying sound judgement to their outputs.
Collaborate with colleagues to turn experimental results into maintainable product capabilities and help shape effective ways of working as the team grows.


To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:


Bring relevant experience in applied machine learning, including taking models from experimentation through deployment and improving them in production.
Have practical experience with classical machine learning and deep learning on real-world data, and write maintainable Python.
Take initiative in exploring open-ended problems, designing useful experiments and moving work forward independently within an established technical direction.
Can design useful experiments, evaluate results critically and explain what a model can and cannot do.
Are curious about emerging ML technologies, data, model behaviour and product needs, and can evaluate results critically to explain what a model can and cannot do.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 15 researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to senior engineer/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

What you will do:



Train state-of-the-art machine learning models
Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge
Define and supervise data annotation tasks
Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings
Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks




What you will need:



MSc or PhD in a relevant field
Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects
Great coding skills
Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts
Ability to examine details closely and critically




Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

LI-MG1

 

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Title: Dataanalytiker til Efterretnings- og Analysecentret i National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du få forskellige datakilder til at tale sammen og finde mønstre og forbindelser i store, komplekse datamængder? Og vil du bruge dine kompetencer inden for dataanalyse og programmering til at styrke politiets indsats mod organiseret kriminalitet? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Din nye hverdag

Efterretnings- og Analysecenteret (EAC) er en del af National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK), som samler politiets og anklagemyndighedens specialiserede indsats mod organiseret, økonomisk og digital kriminalitet.

I Sektionen for analyse og projekter udarbejder vi analyser og efterretningsprodukter, som giver NSK bedre grundlag for at træffe taktiske, operative og strategiske beslutninger. Vi følger og kortlægger udviklingen i de kriminelle miljøer og undersøger nye kriminalitetstyper, fremgangsmåder og trusler.

Den viden omsætter vi til kriminalitets- og efterretningsanalyser, som giver ledelsen et oplyst og kvalificeret grundlag for at træffe beslutninger.

Som dataanalytiker har du en specialiseret rolle i den datamæssige del af analysearbejdet. Du samler og bearbejder data fra politiets egne systemer og eksterne datakilder og får forskellige formater og strukturer til at hænge sammen. Du omsætter rå data til et gennemarbejdet og dokumenteret datagrundlag, som sektionens øvrige analytikere kan bruge i deres analyser og vurderinger. Din opgave er dermed ikke primært at skrive de endelige analyseprodukter, men at finde de mønstre og forbindelser, som gør dem mulige og kvalificerer deres konklusioner.

Du Arbejder Blandt Andet Med At


udtrække, rense, strukturere og kvalitetssikre store og komplekse datasæt
koble data fra forskellige kilder og bearbejde data, der gør sammenhænge analyserbare og synlige
Udføre netværksanalyser (SNA) og andre kvantitative analyser, der synliggør relationer, mønstre og afvigelser
bruge eksempelvis Python eller R i dit arbejde med bearbejdning og analyse af store datasæt
udvikle og anvende metoder inden for ex. machine learning, der kan kvalificere eller effektivisere analysearbejdet
dokumentere datagrundlag, metoder og begrænsninger, så kollegerne kan anvende resultaterne sikkert.


Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med analytikere og andre fagligheder om at skabe det bedst mulige datagrundlag for vores analyser. Vi deler viden, udfordrer hinandens perspektiver og hjælper hinanden på tværs af sektionen. Omgangstonen er uformel, og vi lægger vægt på et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi vil være de bedste på vores område og lægger vægt på faglig udvikling og nye idéer. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine egne kompetencer og bidrage til sektionens fortsatte udvikling. Vores arbejde er vigtigt og meningsfyldt, og vi ved af erfaring, at gode analyser kan få stor betydning for NSK’s arbejde.

Vores nye kollega

Vi søger dig, der har stærke dataanalytiske kompetencer og erfaring med at strukturere, koble og modellere data fra forskellige kilder. Du kan bruge programmering, eksempelvis Python eller R, til at behandle data og løse komplekse problemstillinger. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med machine learning, og det er en særlig fordel, hvis du også kan arbejde med social netværksanalyse, og skabe overblik over relationer mellem personer, grupper og hændelser.

Du har en relevant universitetsuddannelse, fx inden for social data Science eller et andet samfundsvidenskabeligt eller dataanalytisk område. Erfaring fra en lignende stillinger en fordel, herunder gerne i politiet eller andre efterretningsbaserede virksomheder og myndigheder. men det er ikke et krav.

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du:


Kan omsætte data, metoder og komplekse resultater til viden, som dine kolleger kan forstå og anvende
har en stærk talforståelse og kan visualisere data klart og forståeligt
arbejder analytisk, selvstændigt og struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
tager initiativ og bringer din faglighed i spil i samarbejdet med andre
kan sætte dig ind i organisationens og analytikernes behov
Kan kommunikere sikkert på engelsk og dansk.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes på overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Der er til stillingen knyttet en fuldt arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit arbejdssted bliver National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet med adresse på Ejby Industrivej 125-135, 2600 Glostrup.

Din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer inkl. betalt frokostpause. Vores normale åbningstid er mandag-onsdag kl. 8-16, torsdag kl. 8-15 og fredag kl. 8-14, men vi tilbyder flekstid og mulighed for i høj grad selv at tilrettelægge din arbejdstid. Efter en grundig introduktion til stillingen og dine kolleger, tilbyder vi muligheden for hjemmearbejde op til to dage om ugen

Politiet ønsker at understøtte og fremme medarbejdernes fysiske sundhed. Derfor har vi røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid. Vi har en fælles kantine, der tilbyder morgenmad og frokostbuffet med salatbar og et bredt udvalg af sunde retter. Efterretnings- og Analysecenteret (EAC) er en del af National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK), som samler politiets og anklagemyndighedens specialiserede indsats mod organiseret, økonomisk og digital kriminalitet.

Du samler og bearbejder data fra politiets egne systemer og eksterne datakilder og får forskellige formater og strukturer til at hænge sammen. Du omsætter rå data til et gennemarbejdet og dokumenteret datagrundlag, som sektionens øvrige analytikere kan bruge i deres analyser og vurderinger. Title: AI Engineer
Description:
AI Engineer (Data Science Background) | LLM & RAG | Snowflake




📍 Denmark | Hybrid | Full-time, permanent




Our client is scaling its AI and data function and is looking for an AI Engineer with a strong data science foundation to design and ship production Generative AI applications. You'll work at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a modern Snowflake data platform — turning enterprise data into AI-powered tools that real teams rely on.




This is a hands-on, build-and-own role for someone who wants to move GenAI proofs of concept into robust, monitored production systems, not just experiment in notebooks.




𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

Design, build and deploy LLM-powered applications, agents and copilots from prototype through to production
Architect and optimise RAG pipelines — chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector store management and retrieval/re-ranking tuning
Build AI and semantic search capability natively within Snowflake, leveraging Cortex functions, Cortex Search and Snowpark (Python)
Integrate foundation models (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-source LLMs) via orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex
Develop and maintain data pipelines and document ingestion flows that feed AI applications with clean, governed data from Snowflake
Apply data science fundamentals — evaluation metrics, experimentation and statistical rigour — to benchmark and improve performance
Implement MLOps/LLMOps practices — versioning, monitoring, logging and evaluation harnesses




𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿

Solid experience in AI/ML engineering, data science or software engineering, with hands-on exposure to LLM-based applications in production
Practical experience building RAG systems, including vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, or Snowflake Cortex Search)
Strong working knowledge of Snowflake, ideally including Snowpark and Cortex AI functions
Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
A genuine data science grounding — comfortable with model evaluation, statistics and experiment design
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
Fluent English required; Danish an advantage but not essential




𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘃𝗲

Experience with AI agent frameworks and tool/function-calling patterns
Exposure to Databricks alongside Snowflake
Background in MLOps tooling (MLflow, Airflow, Prefect)
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or related field




𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁'𝘀 𝗢𝗻 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿

Build AI capability from the ground up within a well-resourced, data-mature organisation
A modern tech stack centred on Snowflake, with genuine autonomy over architecture decisions
Competitive salary, benefits package and hybrid working
Clear scope to grow into a senior or lead AI engineering position

How will you contribute to shaping a better future—together?

Are you ready to kick-start your career in a collaborative and high-performing environment? Join our Data and Analytics team at EY-Parthenon and work alongside experienced colleagues on challenging and meaningful projects from day one.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in the Data & Analytics team, you will help our clients uncover the key drivers behind their businesses by combining analytics, technology, and commercial understanding. Working across mergers, acquisitions, and strategic initiatives, you will analyze large and complex datasets, develop innovative solutions, and apply advanced analytics and AI to answer critical business questions and support strategic decision-making.

As part of a Nordic-wide team with diverse backgrounds spanning data science, engineering, finance, and accounting, you will have the opportunity to work on projects across the Nordic countries, working side by side with talented colleagues who will support and guide you from day one.

To learn more about our various teams within EY-Parthenon, please visit our career site.

What We Look For


You have a dynamic, growth-focused mindset. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds who bring curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to grow. How you absorb information and take action matters as much as your education and experience. Varied perspectives make our team stronger.
You are curious and purpose driven. You see opportunities, ask insightful questions, and have a genuine interest in finance, M&A, technology and analytics — with a curiosity for emerging innovations and technology trends.
Graduating in 2027 or have recently completed a relevant master’s degree. We welcome applications from a variety of academic backgrounds. Relevant fields may include Economics, Finance, Data Science and Engineering.

An analytical mindset and a genuine enjoyment of tackling complex problems.



Ability to collaborate effectively in teams with people from varying technical and personal backgrounds.



Strong communication and presentation skills.



Experience/knowledge of programming language, data modelling, visualization and AI/ML using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive recruitment experience, please let us know if you require any accommodation during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Sea Ice/Ocean Scientist with Experience on Remote Sensing, Model Diagnostics and Evaluation
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) opens a 4 year full time position for an experienced scientist to work with satellite and in-situ observations to assess the suitability of hybrid-ML/AI and end-to-end data-driven methods to replace classical (physics based) methods in the production of future reanalyses (e.g. ERA7)





Most of the work is carried out in the Horizon Europe project, CHERRI, led by European Center for Medium Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF). DMI has a task in the project to lead the activities about evaluating atmospheric reanalysis systems with a particular focus on oceans and the high latitudes, including ice sheets and sea ice. It is expected that you will be the technical and scientific lead on these activities that include developing a system which enables easy assessment of various NWP reanalysis products and on interpreting on the results to provide feedback to the model developers in CHERRI. DMI is a leading European developer and producer of remote sensing products, including surface temperature products for the global ocean and high latitudes, sea ice concentration and emissivity products for the Polar Oceans and you will use these products in the assessment.





In addition, you will participate in the work within the Copernicus Marine Service and the Copernicus Climate Change projects to produce operational and timely updates of the satellite surface temperature products.





You will work in close collaboration with dedicated and highly qualified colleagues in the remote sensing group and colleagues from other institutions across Europe and you will be writing peer reviewed publications and representing DMI in new research projects and in international organizations.



 

Main working tasks




Lead the tehnical and scientific development within the HEU CHERRI WP 9 “Work on NWP reanalysis model evaluation and diagnostics”


Develop diagnostics to assess the ability of hybrid-ML and end-to-end data-driven analysis methods to produce physically consistent earth-system states and trends.


Lead the communication and reporting to the project on the evaluation and diagnostics.


Develop and implement a processing code base that will enable multi model validation and intercomparison with satellite products, with focus on oceans and high latitudes.


Contribute to Copernicus Marine and C3S data processing


Represent DMI within the international science community through participation in international collaborations and contribute to new satellite missions.






 



Your qualifications




Recognized scientist with expertise on NWP/Reanalysis evaluation.


Experience working with satellite observations.


Experience with physical ocean and sea ice processes. 


Good communication skills and a scientific publication list.


Advanced programming skills in e.g. Python (preferrable) orFortran .


Experience with Linux and GIT


Good skills in oral and written English.


Can work well in a team in close collaboration with your colleagues.



 





The position is in the Danish National Centre for Climate Research (NCKF) at DMI, which employs approximately 80 scientists of which 20 are located in the Satellites and Arctic unit. We have a strong international profile which is also reflected in the many nationalities here and in an English "working language".





 



Employment and Salary 



Will be according to the Danish Law and Agreements, specifically the Collective Agreement for State-Employed Academics (AC-overenskomsten). It will be possible to negotiate an addition to the basic salary depending on your qualifications and experience. DMI offers a flexible working week of 37 hours including a paid lunch break, and six weeks of paid vacation annually. Job Description

Are you interested in becoming a bioinformatics researcher working to improve the treatment and prognoses of colorectal cancer patients?

Then this is the position for you. You will join the ongoing efforts of researchers at the Department of Health Technology at the Technical University of Denmark and the Center for Surgical Science (CSS) at the University Hospital Zealand in Køge. The overall aim of this project is to integrate phenotypic data from national population-wide registries with multi omics data generated to characterize colorectal cancer samples and ultimately predict postoperative recurrence of the disease.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

You will work at the interface of artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, and clinical research. The project aims to develop novel computational models that integrate nationwide longitudinal health data with microbiome and genomic data to better understand adenoma-to-carcinoma progression and support clinically relevant decision-making. The candidate will contribute to the development of foundation models for sequence data and patient trajectories, representation learning approaches for microbial genomes and microbiomes, and predictive models linking molecular and clinical data to cancer risk stratification.

The work will be carried out in close collaboration with computational researchers at DTU and clinical experts at the Center for Surgical Science. The project offers a unique opportunity to work with nationwide Danish health registries, large-scale microbiome datasets, and state-of-the-art machine learning methods.

You are expected to:


Develop and apply machine learning and foundation-model approaches for large-scale longitudinal health data and large-scale genomic data.
Integrate clinical, microbiome, and genomic data to uncover factors associated with adenoma progression and colorectal cancer development.
Develop computational representations of patient trajectories and microbial communities using modern AI and bioinformatics methodologies.


The following qualifications are required:


A master's degree in bioinformatics, computer science, computational biology, data science, biomedical engineering, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with statistical analysis and machine learning.
Experience handling and analyzing large-scale biological or health-related datasets.


You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 18 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
Curriculum vitae
Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale


You may apply prior to ob­tai­ning your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. Title: One or more PhD Positions in Unsupervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis
Description:
At the Faculty of Medicine, Department of Health Science and Technology, one or more PhD stipends in Unsupervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis are available for appointment from November 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.



The appointment is for a period of three years.



The successful candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme in Biomedical Engineering and Neuroscience at the Faculty of Medicine.



Who we are



The Department of Health Science and Technology (HST) at Aalborg University is an interdisciplinary research and teaching environment where engineering, medicine and health sciences come together to improve people's lives. 



As a PhD fellow at HST, you will become part of an international research community with access to experienced supervisors, modern research facilities and strong interdisciplinary collaboration. You will work alongside researchers from a wide range of disciplines and engage with hospitals, industry and public-sector partners to address some of society's most important health challenges.



The department is home to approximately 180 academic staff members, around 100 PhD fellows and more than 1,700 students. We offer a stimulating research environment that encourages scientific curiosity, collaboration and professional development.



The Faculty of Medicine is committed to preparing PhD graduates for diverse career paths. Throughout your PhD, you will develop advanced research competencies alongside transferable skills that prepare you for careers in academia, industry and the public sector. Towards the end of your PhD, you will be offered dedicated career development support to help you plan your next career step.



At HST, our values – Share. Care. Dare. – shape the way we collaborate, support one another and create knowledge with societal impact.



Learn more about the department on our website and in our research portal.



Opportunistic screening envisions a scenario in which all acquired medical images are studied in minute detail to detect the early signs of any disease. When combined with AI tools, this has the potential to

detect diseases earlier, giving the best chance of improving patient outcomes
reduce the burden placed on radiologists and democratize diagnostic expertise to more healthcare institutions
maximize the utility of collected radiological data

One of the major barriers to achieving this, is figuring out how to learn useful patterns in the data without relying on exhaustive labelling. For example, in the anomaly detection setting, we often assume that only healthy images are available during training. Using this, we wish to learn the appearance and structure of healthy anatomy and detect any deviation from the healthy distribution. But in the absence of labels, how should we direct the model to learn relevant features, and how can we determine which features are relevant? These questions are at the core of anomaly detection and despite being a well-established field of research, these are still very much open problems.



To this end, we are looking for candidates interested in developing new machine learning methods for medical image analysis, with a particular focus in anomaly detection and unsupervised learning. In this position, you will have the chance to explore basic machine learning research as well as more applied projects. While most of the work will involve technical machine learning research, you will also have access to clinical experts and will be expected to collaborate closely with other researchers in the Faculty of Medicine and at Aalborg University Hospital.



Applicants should have:

A strong technical background in machine learning, computing, data science, biomedical engineering, or a related field at the level of a master degree
Programming skills (Python) and experience with common machine learning platforms
Experience with deep learning, computer vision, medical image analysis or unsupervised learning is an advantage.
English language skills, both written and spoken

Qualification requirements



PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School in Medicine, Biomedical Science and Technologyin accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.



How to apply



Your application must include the following:

Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
Research statement (max 1 page excluding references), briefly describing a proposed research project. Include a problem description, a brief summary of existing solutions, and your proposed approach/topic that you would like to investigate.
References (optional)
Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 



Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.



Do you have any questions?     



If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.



Further information  



Read more about our recruitment process here.



The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.



Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.



The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.



Read more about The Doctoral School in Medicine, Biomedical Science and Technology



Salary and terms of employment



The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 



You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.



There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.



Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world



Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Job Description

Are you interested in probabilistic machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and sequential decision-making?

Then this post-doc position may be for you.

DTU Compute invites applications for a fully funded post-doc position with a duration up to two years.

The position is part of the research grant “Active Inference for Dynamic Pricing”, funded by the Fund of 20th December. The overall aim of the project is to investigate active inference as a principled framework for developing robust methods for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, building on state-of-the-art machine learning methods and architectures. The project will investigate and validate the developed methodology through several real-world applications, including dynamic pricing.

You will be part of the Section for Cognitive Systems , a dynamic and research-oriented group of scientists, technical personnel, and administrative staff. We have a broad interest in machine learning and information processing in humans and computers and a particular focus on the signals they exchange.

Responsibilities

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will conduct independent and collaborative research on probabilistic machine learning and active inference for sequential decision-making under uncertainty. Your work will involve developing novel models and algorithms, as well as implementing and evaluating them using modern machine learning frameworks. You will investigate the proposed methodology through realistic use cases, including dynamic pricing. The position also includes disseminating research results through publications in leading international journals and conferences, and participating in scientific collaborations. As a post-doc, you will also contribute to the academic environment at DTU Compute, including limited teaching and supervision activities.

Qualifications:


Proven expert knowledge and experience in probabilistic machine learning and deep learning
Excellent analytical and mathematical problem-solving skills
Excellent programming skills (Python and modern machine learning frameworks like PyTorch, JaX, etc.) and experience in working with HPC/GPU environments
A track record of publication and presentation of research results in quality journals/conferences.


As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent) in machine learning, signal processing, data science or a related field.

Title: Scientist, Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology (PK/PD Modeling & Simulation)
Description:
Join Hemab, a clinical-stage biotech company, on an exciting journey to build the ultimate clotting company. We focus on addressing the high unmet needs of patients suffering from rare bleeding and thrombotic disorders. With offices in Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark, Hemab cultivates a vibrant, agile and forward-thinking environment where collaboration, innovation, and high-quality biotherapeutics development go hand in hand.

As a Scientist, PK/PD Modeling & Simulation, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying population PK, PK/PD, exposure–response and QSP models to support model-informed drug development across Hemab’s pipeline. You will work closely with internal cross-functional leads (clinical pharmacology, nonclinical, clinical development, biometrics, regulatory and quality) and external collaborators (CROs and consultants) to provide quantitative insights that inform dose selection, clinical study design, and regulatory filings. Your work will be central to integrating modeling and simulation strategies into Hemab’s clinical programs and advancing our mission to deliver first-in-class therapies to patients with rare bleeding disorders.

At Hemab, we foster an environment where everyone can wear multiple hats depending on their experience, fit, and motivation to get things done. We constantly strive to celebrate our achievements collectively and gather feedback to continuously sustain and improve our fast-paced, cross-functional work environment.




What you'll do at Hemab?

Develop, validate, and execute population PK, PK/PD exposure–response, PBPK and QSP models to support dose selection, regimen optimization, and trial design.
Perform simulations to inform early clinical study design, establish clinical proof-of-concept (PoC), and guide pivotal program decisions.
Analyze preclinical and clinical PK/PD data, translating insights into actionable recommendations for clinical teams.
Contribute quantitative components for regulatory submissions (INDs, CTAs, BLAs) and respond to agency questions on modeling and simulation deliverables.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure modeling insights are integrated into development plans and communicated clearly to stakeholders.
Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and new quantitative methods to continuously improve modeling strategies and workflows.
Support vendor and consultant selection and management to ensure high-quality, timely deliverables for modeling and simulation activities.
Be a proactive and collaborative team player, receptive to constructive feedback and committed to meeting program goals.




Who You Are and What You'll Bring to Hemab?

Education: Ph.D. in Pharmacometrics, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacokinetics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; with 1–3 years of relevant experience.
Experience: Hands-on experience with population PK/PD modeling software (NONMEM, Monolix, Phoenix NLME) and programming languages (R, MATLAB). Strong understanding of PK/PD principles, biologics drug development, and model-informed drug development strategies.
Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: biologics PK/PD, rare disease development, translational modeling, or target-mediated drug disposition (TMDD). Familiarity with quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) approaches is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex quantitative data to diverse audiences, including cross-functional teams and regulatory authorities.
Experience contributing to or supporting regulatory submissions is desirable.
Excellent problem-solving skills, scientific curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced biotech environment.
